tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs gnyis pa bzhugs so// na mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /dza ga tau gu ru sarb+bi ya 'gro ba'i bla ma thams cad la/ sarb+ba dzñā ya phan par mdzad pa'i kun mkhyen la/ bsod nams mar rgad 'khyil pa'i chu gter dbus na rin chen gzhal med khang brtsegs rnam par bkra ba'i khyams kyi nang du rtag 'khod nas/ /lhun gyi grub pa'i rmad byung 'dod dgu kun stsol mkhyen pa'i nor bu ind+ra nī la thugs rje'i yan lag mchog gis gtsug tu brgyan/ /legs par gsungs pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas padma rā ga'i 'od can ro 'dzin dbang pos rnam kun mchog ldan phu ṭa'i dbyangs sgrogs shing / /rgyal ba'i mtshan dang dpe byad dpal gyi gzi 'od rab 'phro gser bzang rgyan gyi nye bar mdzes pa'i mkhas mchog klu yi dbang por 'dud/ /bsod nams dang ye shes bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i tshogs gnyis las lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs rgya mtsho lta bu la longs spyod pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po dri ma med pa'i gzhung lugs 'bum phrag du ma'i 'byung gnas grub pa chen po'i sa la mngon par bzhugs shing / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs kun tu bsgrengs pas srid zhi'i dpal yon bzang pos nor 'dzin byang phyogs bho ṭa'i yul khams phan bder mdzad pa'i 'dren pa dam pa rje btsun pu ṇḍ+ya ni rā bho ga su bhā kā ra dhwa dza shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas legs par bshad pa'i gsung rab thos pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bskur ba dang / byin rlabs rjes gnang nod pa dang / bshad bka'i lung sogs ji ltar mnos pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni thog mar bya ba spyi'i rgyud nas bshad pa rigs gsum spyi'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ badzra dha ra/ badzra pā ṇi/ ma hā int+ra bhū ti/ ma dhā ma/ mṛ dhu/ nā gārdzu na/ nā ga bo dhi/ kha che ye shes rdo rje/

lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rtse mo/ /rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ de gnyis ka la dkar ston shākya grags/ de nas ba de lung pa kun bzang dpal/ gung pa dharma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang / gnyag ston byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung nas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi lung yang thob bo// ༈ /rdo rje rnam 'joms lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid bram ze ma ṇi badzra gyi lugs kyi dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/byams pa/ gaṃ ga dha ra/ ma ṇi badzra/ dza ya warma/ ye shes dpal/ lo tsā ba cog gru rab zhi/ yon tan legs/ bsam gtan dbang phyug don grub ye shes/ chos kyi blo gros/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ don ye gnyis pa/ dkon mchog rdo rje/ shes rab 'bum/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bur ston bsod dbang / bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ bya sder ba byang chub gzhon nu/ bya sder ba mkhan po byams pa rin chen/ bya sder ba byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs gam̐ ga dha ras mdzad pa/ lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs/ gzungs bsgrub/ las bzhi'i bum chog las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rnams ma ṇi ka badzras mdzad pa/ las sgrub pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa/ de nyid dang rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis bsgyur/ bstod pa rnams thos so/ /gzungs gra lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ je tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa tshe chung gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/

mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ yang na ba ri ba nas/ gnyan ston grags/ gnyan rin grags/ lha sa'i gnas brtan rin seng / de sras rtog ston bya'u rgyal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ bla ma sher seng / 'phags 'od pa/ bu ston man 'dra'o/ /bsrung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs dzi tā ris mdzad pa/ dze na rakṣi ta dang seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/ 'khor lo bri thabs dze tā ris mdzad pa ba ri bas 'gyur rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ dze tā ri/ ye shes zhabs/ ba ti kā ri/ shu la tsand+ra/ ratna shrī/ ma hā shrī/ pu ru ṣotta ma/ lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rin chen grub/ khyung lhas pa/ shar pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ bod yig dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa yang thos so/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa tshe chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ skyu ra a skyabs/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun grags pa/ pho rog pa mde sde mgon/ rgan mo lhas pa/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ rong pa a ka ra/ dkon mchog tshul khrims/ bag ston/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ gtsug tor mchog grub ma gzu dga' rdor gyi bsgyur/ sgrub thabs dang bstod pa gi ri warmas mdzad pa/ 'khor lo bri thabs dze tā ris mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs 'phags pas mdzad pa/ dkyil chog dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa/ las tshogs nyer lnga glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa rnams kyang thos so/ /'od zer can lha lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ ba ri ba/ sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ rga lo/ sher seng / 'phags 'od/ bu ston pa/

rin rnams pa/ bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ gzungs ba ri bas bsgyur/ sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung / sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg bstod pa rnams 'phags pas mdzad pa/ dkyil chog bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa/ dbang chog gi zin bris dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung yang thos so/ /tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang gis brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sangs rgyas chen po/ bla chen bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od/ e pa 'khon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ye/ grags pa dpal/ sru lung pa kun smon/ brag phug pa chen po/ blo gros bstan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs dkyil chog bstod pa rnams dze tā ris mdzad pa/ mañdzu shrī dang / lce dga' ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur/ sru lung pas mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams kyang thos so/ /gza' yum gyi byab srung gi brgyud pa ni/ birwa pa/ zhi ba 'tsho/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ gtsug tor shes rab/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / bal po shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen/ rje pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ mkhan po gzhon nu 'bum/ grags chen/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ gzungs rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur bcos mdzad pa dang / sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i mchod chog rnams kyang thos/ bcu gcig zhal lha so bdun ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ spyan ras gzigs/ dpal ldan a ti sha 'brom ston pa/

spyan snga tshul 'bar/ bya yul ba/ mu sman pa/ dpal ldan gro mo che/ stag ston shes rab 'od zer/ dmar ston bsod nams 'phel/ slob dpon shāka 'bum/ don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang / mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub dkyil grags pa tshul khrims pas mdzad pa thos so/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la dpa' bo gcig grub nas gsungs pa'i a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor bskyang / kun dga' snying po/ shes rab bskyang / zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan gshin rje/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal gyo blo gros grags/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen dol po ba/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs dang mchod chog shrad dhās mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/ bstod pa ti la ka ka la shas mdzad pa/ gtso bo'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad/ bstod pa rgyud gsum 'khor lo/ /mtshan brjod 'don thams/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog ye shes snang ba'i sgron ma rnams rje btsun gyis mdzad pa thos so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor bskyang / kun dga' snying po/ shes rab bskyang / zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dang byed go cha/ lo chen rin bzang / brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal gyo blo gros grags/ bla ma sa chen/ gnyag ston dbang rgyal/ rje btsun grags pa/

sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa chen po/ blo gros bstan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs/ rdo rje tshe'i man ngag sogs tshang bar thob bo/ rnal 'byor bla med la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis kyi dang po la/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ bī ra ḍi pa/ gam̐ bhi ra ma ti/ niska laṅka de ba/ ra be nd+ra/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa/ bla ma buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ yang na gshin rje'i gshed/ dā na shī la/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa man gong dang 'dra'o/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor ra lugs kyi dbang gi brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la la ti badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas ba/ padma badzra/ dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng / klog kya dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang po/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ rwa 'gyur/ zhal dgu pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ phyag drug rnams kyi sgrub thabs/ rwa rdo rje grags kyi mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs/ bdag 'jug sbyin sreg rnams 'phags pas mdzad pa/ phrin las char 'bebs rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa lag len dang bcas pa thos so/

/rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ padma badzra/ dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng / rong pa rga lo/ rong pa sher seng / nyang stod 'phags pa/ bla ma grags chen/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma drag po'i dbang dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ a mo gha badzra che ba/ a mo gha badzra chung ba/ skyo 'od byung / skyo sku mched/ jo sras khams pa/ gnyan rin chen brtan/ de'i sras gnyan 'od srungs/ gnyan chos rgyal/ 'jim pa rin she/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ bla ma la ru ba/ bla ma klog kya ba/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdus pa a mo gha badzra che bas mdzad pa/ mañdzu shrī dzñā na dang / rong zom chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga a mo gha badzra chung pas mdzad pa/ de nyid dang / zhang shes rab bla mas bsgyur/ sbyin sreg a mo gha badzra che pas mdzad pa rwa 'gyur/ drag po'i rjes gnang 'dzin pa rin shes mdzad pa rnams kyang thos so/ /'jigs byed lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ mañdzu shrī mi tra/ a mo gha badzra che ba/ chung ba/ skyo 'od byung / skyo sku mched/ jo sras khams pa/ gnyan rin chen brtan/ gnyan 'od srungs/ gnyan chos rgyal/ 'jim pa rin chen shes rab/ bzhi thog pa 'jam dbyangs/ bla ma cha gan/ klog kya grags chen/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/

chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs la li ta badzra gyis mdzad pa/ klog kya'i bsgyur/ zhi khro rnam rol gyi sgrub thabs 'phags pas mdzad pa thos so/ /dgra nag zhang lugs kyi dbang drag po'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ la li badzra/ sau su ra pa/ she na pa/ a ba li na pa/ ku ṇa pa bha dra/ wā gī shwa ra kīrti/ de bā ka ra tsant+ra/ a mo gha badzra/ pradzñā gu ru/ sadgha bha dra/ rin po che gcen/ tsandan 'od po/ gcung rdo rje rtse mo/ /dpal gti mug rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje/ dpal rdo rje gsang ba'i ye shes/ rje bsam gtan gling pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba/ 'jim pa rin she/ shar pa kun dga' seng ge/ 'jim pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs dkyil chog 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa ston pa gshin rje'i gshed 'byung ba rab sgyings rdo rjes mdzad pa/ zhang shes rab bla mas bsgyur/ rdzogs rim rim pa bzhi'i bye brag bstan pa de wa ā ka ra tsand+ras mdzad pa zhang gis bsgyur/ kha snga pa rin chen 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams thos so/ /gshin rje'i gshed gdong drug rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' gro ma/ nag po pa/ bha da pa/ dha ma pa/ de wa pa/ dze tā ri/ a naṃ ga badzra/ dharmā ka ra ma ti/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng / rje btsun rga lo/ rong pa sher seng / bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston/ rin rnam pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ sa wa ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta de wa purṇa ma ti/ lo tsā ba 'gar chos kyi bzang po/

gshen ston rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rdo rje/ thub pa shes rab/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ gan chag pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ 'jim pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ma ti paṇḍi ta/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ gos sngon can gyi gzungs/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ srung ba'i bsgyur/ mngon rtogs rnam dag 'od chen/ phyi mchod dang / 'byung po'i gtor chog dkyil chog rnams dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa ste lung de dag gi brgyud pa ni/ gong ma rnams dbang dang 'dra ba las/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ dmar shākya grub/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ ma rgyud la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi dbang bskur gyi nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ra pa/ lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ antar pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa/ klog kya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal tshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri pa/ lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs can/ shrī dza landha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ gu hya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog kya pa/ mal lo/ /sa chen/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/

ri khrod pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ mngon par rtogs pa klog kyas bsgyur/ dkyil chog lo chen gyis bsgyur la chos dbang dang blo gros grags kyis bcos pa/ sbyin sreg dharmā shrī bha dra dang rig pa gzhon nus bsgyur/ o la pa ti/ dpyid kyi thig le/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsum 'brog mi'i 'gyur te nag po gzhung drug tu grags pa dang / dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed rgyas pa/ de'i cho ga rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ nag po dkyil chog 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs rnams thos shing nag po gzhung drug gi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇḍi ta yan chad gong dang 'dra ba las/ de nas tshogs sgom rin po che/ 'u yug pa/ bla ma grags chen/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ 'bar ba 'dzin/ kāhna pa/ gu hya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog kya pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ slob dpon chen po/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ nyan che bsod nams brtan pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs mar do chos dbang gi bsgyur/ dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi bsgyur/ rim lnga mal gyis bsgyur la rngog gis bcos pa rnams thos shing / dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs dang / dbang chog gnyis rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs dang tshes bcu'i mchod pa rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ lus dkyil lam dus kyi yig cha shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rnams thos so/

/bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rnal 'byor ma/ ratna shrī/ ka lya na shānti/ ma ti/ wa ni te bha dra/bhū me shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ shong blo gros brtan pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bde ba can pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ de gnyis ka la rin chen grags tshul ba/ de nas mkhas btsun byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ dril bu lha lnga ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / dril bu pa/ laṅka ling pa/ nag po spyod pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa 'jigs med grags pa/ su ma ti kīrti/ mar pa do pa/ gze ba blo ldan/ gze ba jo bde/ shākya rdo rje/ rong pa chos mgon/ mchog ldan/ dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston rin po che/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje rtog med zhabs/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ nam mkha' rdo rje/ yon tan dpal bzang / rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang / khwa char ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rdo rje man 'dra/ 'di'i sgrub thabs dril bu pas mdzad pa mar do'i bsgyur/ yang 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gnyis kyi lung yang thos so/ 'khor lo bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lū hi pa/ dheṃ gi pa/ la wa pa ind+ra bhū ti/ ka tsa ḍa pa/ dril bu pa/ dza landhar pa/ nag po pa/ ku sha li/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā na/ bal po bha dan ta/ mar pa do pa/ gze pa blo ldan/ gze pa jo bde/ lho tshad pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/

chos rje bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga grub chen la wa pas mdzad pa mar do'i bsgyur ba yang thos so/ /ma hā mā ya lha lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ ḍoṃ bi wa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ paṇḍi ta zhi ba bzang po/ mar pa lho brag pa/ rngog chos rdor/ sras mdo sde/ rngog chos sku/ rngog tsha dkon mchog dpal/ klog kya dbang phyug grags/ ldong stong shes rab dpal/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ mkhan po gzhon nu 'bum/ bla ma kīrti shī/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs rmongs pa sgrol ba dang / dkyil chog ku ku ri pas mdzad pa na wi ko tra dang / 'gos kyis bsgyur/ rdzogs rim shin tu spros med dang gtor chog ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rtsa 'grel gnyis blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa 'gos bsgyur rnams thob/ /sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ra/ mai tri pa/ mar pa lo tsā/ rgya rnal 'byor pa/ ro mnyam rdo rje/ yon tan grags/ khams pa shākya/ gnyal pa chos grags/ rgan mo lhas pa byang chub dpal/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ chos rje byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ shar pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa'i mngon bdag gnyis kyi lung yang thos so/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las gsungs pa'i sdom pa chen po'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'chi med 'tsho/ gnyis med dpal 'dzin/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bikṣa ta de wa/ shākya shrī/ kasmi ra/ bhū mi shrī/ sha shwa ta/ a pa ra/ kasmi ta/

glo ston lo tsā ba/ bla ma chos 'dzin/ bla ma ngag dbang / mkhan chen byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs glo ston lo tsā pas mdzad pa yang thos so/ /rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kulle lha lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / mkhan chen chos rin/ chos rje dge gdings pa/ bla ma bsgom pa/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rin po che/ yang na kha che paṇa chen/ dā na shī la/ sa paṇa/ 'u yug pa kun bsod/ nyi thog pa kun smon/ yon tan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ ku ru kulle'i bstod pa/ sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i yi ge rnams thos so/ /rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba/ gcung rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ gtsug tor shes rab/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / 'khon ston bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa skya pa kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dpal chen 'od po/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/

yang na rje btsun pa/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang dra/ yang na/ rje sa paṇa/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ 'phags pa mchog ldan/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal man 'dra'o/ /phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud chos rje paṇḍi tas bsgyur/ dkyil chog las rim/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa de nyid dang gnyag dzñā na ku mā ras bsgyur ba/ sgrub thabs bklags pa don grub/ 'bring po don grub snying po/ bsdus pa yang snying lhan skyes rnams chos rje bla mas mdzad pa/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ phur pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma rje btsun pas mdzad par grags pa rnams thos/ phur pa drag po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun yan dbang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra/ de nas chos rje/ chos rgyal/ lo mchog bag ston/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ drag po'i rjes gnang gi yi ge chos rje bla mas mdzad pa yang thos so/ /dpal bde mchog bong bu'i zhal can lha so bdun gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ badzra dha ra rdo rje 'chang / ḍā ki nī mkha' 'gro ma/ a bha yā ka ra gupta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa/ a nu pa ma rakṣi ta dpe med bsrung ba/ darpaṇa ā tsargya 'gro ba'i me long / sa manta bha dra kun tu bzang po/ dzñā na dzyo ti ye shes kyi glog shrī mā nu manta/ dpal yid kyi 'gram pa/ shrī mañdzu bha dra/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ shrī bha dra/ dpal bzang po/ dharma dzyo ti bha dra/ chos kyi glog bzang po/ ma na dzi ba bha dra/ yid mtsho bzang po/ sho tam shrī bha dra/ go tam shrī yin nam gsungs/ shrī bi dza ya bha dra/ dpal rnam rgyal bzang po/ shrī ma da na bha dra pā da dpal myos byed bzang po'i zhabs/

shrī lakṣ+mi bha dra pā da/ dpal phun tshogs bzang po'i zhabs/ ga ga na bha dra/ nam mkha' bzang po/ u da ya dzi ba bha dra/ rgyas pa'i mtsho ba bzang po/ shrī ha ri ṣa bha dra pā da dpal 'phrog byed bzang po'i zhabs/ ā bha ga bha dra/ skal ldan bzang po 'di bal po ye rang gi paṇḍi ta/ bal yul ye rang gi paṇḍi ta dza gad ā nanda dzi ba bha dra/ skye dgu kun dga'i 'tsho ba bzang po/ de'i sras ma hā bo dhi byang chub chen po/ bla ma bsam gtan 'od zer/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag la'o/ /nye brgyud ni bde mchog yab yum/ a bhā ka bha dra/ ā nanda dzi wa bha dra man gong dang 'dra/ bla ma paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil yang thos so/ /dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ rje ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung pa/ zhang dgon pa/ chos rje sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ chos rje yon tan dpal bzang / rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /dpal kyai rdo rje ḍoṃ bi he ru ka'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ bi ḍoṃ bi he ru ka/ a la la badzra/ nags khrod pa/ garbha ri pa/ dza ya shrī dzñā na/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/

bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ rong pa rga lo/ rong pa sher seng / zhang grags 'byor/ bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ grub chen mtsho skyes lugs kyi kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bi lasya badzra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ ind+ra bhū ti/ lcam lakṣ+mī/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa/ sa chen/ rta stag so ba khu dbon/ dpal chu bo ri pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ slob dpon nag po pa'i lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhir dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ nag po shanta bha dra/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ /bla ma rje btsun/ dkar shākya grags/ ba de lung pa kun bzang dpal/ gung pa dar ma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwapa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ rje ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ rje sa skya pa/ ne tse sbal ston/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam pa ra chos she/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/

de las chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang / bla ma blo gros brtan pa gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka la dpal ldan tshul khrims pas/ de nas grub chen budha shrī/ kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dharm+mā kā yā mi tā bha ba/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ sambho ga kā ya ma hā padma wa shī ta longs sku padma dbang chen/ nirm+mā ṇa ka ya padma ka ra sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ shrī wān ratna bha dra/ dpal ldan rin chen bzang po/ 'dar cha ru ba/ bīrya badzra/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ bo dong rin po che/ pu ṇya sd+yā ri/ bsod nams brtan pa/ nyan chen pa/ dharma rā dza bha dra/ chos rgyal bzang po/ mkhan chen/ shrī mānsingha/ dpal ldan seng ge/ kun mkhyen mu srad pa/ pu ṇya bha dra/ bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen/ gu ṣa ma ti/ yon tan blo gros dgra bcom pa/ swa sti dhwa dza/ bde legs rgyal mtshan/ bha ṭṭā ra ka pu ṇya ni rā bho ga rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /'di'i sgrub thabs mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa dang / dbang chog chos rje bde legs pas mdzad pa'i lung thos so/ /gu ru rigs lnga la mtshan brgyad kyi bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gu ru bka' brgyad ces grags pa'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan/ mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug bla ma sprul sku shākya 'bum/ bla ma sman lung pa/ bla ma be ston chen po/ rnal 'byor bde legs rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/

/'di'i sgrub thabs dang dbang chog bde legs pas mdzad pa thos so/ /rgyud sde zab mo rnams nas gsungs pa'i byin rlabs thob pa la/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ se ston kun rig zhang dgon pa ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /sa lugs kyi mchog bsgrub pa'i dmar mo skor gsum la sangs rgyas dngos kyi slob ma rgyal po dbang po'i 'byor pa nas brgyud pa zhal gnyis ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rnal 'byor ma/ la ba pa/ ind+ra bhū ti/ lcaṃ lakṣ+mī/ birwa pa/ sha wa ra/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje/ bha rend+ra ru tsi/ bal po ye shes rdo rje/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rje rdo rje 'chang / paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i man ngag mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ dhoṃ gi pa/ antar pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ phaṃ thing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung dus 'khor ba/ klog kya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje zhu dbon man sngar bzhin no/ /bde mchog ral pa gyen brjes kyi rgyud las 'byung ba rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma mai tri mkha' spyod kyis byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang / rnal 'byor ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badzra/ dza ya se na/ lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje pa man gong bzhin/ zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs rgyal chen ind+ra bhu tis mdzad pa/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid/ las bcu'i gzhung / bal po bha rend+ras mdzad pa/ mi dbang chos gsum du grags pa/ de gsum gyi don 'grel rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs chung du nā ro ta pa nyid kyis mdzad pa mchan dang bcas pa/ de'i don 'grel rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su blang tshul/ phyi mchod tshogs mchod/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra se na dbab pa/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa/ tshangs pa'i bu mo sgrub pa/ padma pa ti'i man ngag khol po pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len gyi yig skor rnams rje btsun gong mas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg rnams dang rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ yang sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg laṅka liṅka la brten pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub thabs rnams mdzad byang med pa'i lung thob/ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod kyi byin rlabs nas de'i yi ge bla ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ zhal gnyis ma la brten pa'i bsrung bzlog gi yig chung rje mkhan chen pa nyid kyis mdzad pa lag tu blang tshul dang bcas pa thob bo/ /'khor lo bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs thob nas brgyud pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog paṇa che shākya shrī/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ yang na shākya shrī/ dpyal chos bzang /

jo gdan rdo rje dpal/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ rin po che bsod nams grags/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ dpyal a mo ghas mdzad pa'i khrid yig dang rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i lung thob/ dpyal lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ don grub ma/ dbu bcad ma gsum gyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lcaṃ lakṣ+mī ka ra/ birwa pa/ a ba dhū ti pa/ sha ba ra/ bsod snyoms pa che chung / bal po hang ngu dkar po/ de la dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ yang dben pa bsod nams seng ge/ dpyal kun dga' grags gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum ka la lha lung pa rdo rje bzang po/ de nas dpyal chos bzang / rong pa rga lo/ /bla ma shes rab seng ge/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen budhā shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs chung ba sha ba ri pas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs che ba stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rje mdzad pa/ phag mo don grub ma'i sgrub thabs chung ba a wa dhū ti pas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs che ba stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs chung ba lha mo dpal gyi blo gros mas mdzad pa 'di lakṣ+mī ka ra dang gcig gsung / grub thabs che ba birwa pas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg bya tshul sangs rgyas byin gyis mdzad pa de rnams bal po bha rend+ra dang blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/ sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs byed tshul dpyal lugs kyi yi ge rnying pa rnams kyi lung thob/ gzhan yang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog nag po ba'i sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog gi gsal byed re re/

lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs kyi gsol 'debs/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi lung sbyor rgyas pa paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dang / bsdus pa rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ yi ge bdun pa la brten pa'i tshe bsgrub yi ge rnying pa dang bcas pa/ nye snying la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub thabs rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa lag len dang bcas pa/ bde mchog la brten nas yi ge brgya pa'i phyir bzlog bya tshul gyi yi ge rnying pa yang thos so/ /rjes gnang gi skor la/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ 'di'i sgrub thabs dze tā ris mdzad pa/ chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ stong mchod byed lugs dang bcas pa thob/ yang rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa gnyis kyi 'grel pa/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i bshad pa bya rgyud rang rkang ba'i lugs kyi sgrub thabs/ stong phrag bcu gnyis pa'i mchod pa byed lugs/ bum chog dang bcas pa yang thos/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ye shes sdes bsgyur/ rnam rgyal gyi gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa ba ri bas bsgyur rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri nas 'phags pa rin po che'i bar gong dang 'dra/ de nas glo chen/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma bram chen po/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra'o/ /don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i rjes gnang thob nas brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ e ra pa ti/ rigs ngan rnal 'byor pa/ a mo gha badzra/

ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun lho pa/ zhang nyi phug pa chos grags/ drang po lung pa grags tshul/ ku ra mkhan po rgyal mtshan mgon/ slob dpon bsod nams lhun grub/ kun dga' tshul khrims/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags/ don zhags pa sangs rin/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ don zhags kyi gzungs don yod rdo rje dang ba ri bas bsgyur/ sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa rnams thos/ sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ paṇḍi ta shākya shrī/ lho brag pa byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi ba grags pa gzhon nu/ rin po che bsod nams grags/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi slu'i man ngag 'chi med grub pa/ tshe gzugs sogs 'chi ltas brtag pa/ spyan ma/ rma bya chen mo sgrol dkar sogs la brten pa/ rdor bzlas nang gi rlung la brten pa'i tshe bsgrub kyi man ngag zab mo rnams dang / chos rje bla mas mdzad pa'i sgrol dkar gyi sgrub skor gyi lung yang thos so/ /gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gupta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u ba/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rjes/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi ba grags pa gzhon nu/ rin po che bsod nams grags/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang ba/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rjes gnang gi dus su dgos pa mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung yang thob bo/

/mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs/ rjes gnang chu srung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ bsod rtse/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa chen po/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rgyal gzhung / rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams thos so/ /parṇa sha ba ri'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni sa paṇa yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas shar pa gong ma sku mched/ rin chen ye shes/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bsam gtan grub/ glo ston shrī bān bo dhi/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' zang po man gong bzhin/ sha wa ri'i gzungs/ yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/ chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang bcas pa'i lung yang thob/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri nas chos rje sa paṇa gyi bar gong dang 'dra/ de nas rje btsun rga lo/ /sras ā ka ra/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ de'i 'grel pa/ mtshan brjod 'don thabs/ bstod pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge chos rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa rnams thos/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng / pha dam pa/ kha che gu hya pa/ glan sgom yab sras/ slob dpon 'od shāka/ mchog ldan pa/ skyi ston pa/ dol po ba/ ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ 'jam dpal dmar po'i gsung gi sgrub thabs ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/

de'i lo rgyus rjes gnang gi tho yig sgrub thabs las tshogs sbyin sreg 'khor lo bri thabs rnams dam pas mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge gnyis/ las tshogs mang du thos/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ paṇḍi ta ma ti/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ mkhan chen bsod she mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang man gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bstod pa ma tis mdzad pa/ lo rgyus khro phu pas mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge/ sgrub thabs las tshogs rnams rgya ston gyis mdzad pa thos/ 'jam dbyangs ye shes yon tan bzang po'i rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ paṇḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ khyung rin chen grags/ rgya dmar byang chub grags/ cha pa chos seng / gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge/ dan 'bag pa dar ma seng ge/ gnyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ gzad ring dar ma tshul khrims/ gra thang pa bla ma bsod nams rgyal ba/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun bzang man gong bzhin/ bstod pa rdo rje mtshon chas mdzad pa yang thos/ /'jam dbyangs nag po'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ sa skya pa/ rtse mo/ /rje btsun chen po/ sa paṇa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ mnyam med pa/ bla ma shākya/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo gcig grub kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ dga' rab rdo rje/ mi pham gshin rje/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rje btsun/ chos rje paṇḍi ta/ dngos ston tshul/ rgyal tsha/ mchog ldan/ bsod nams dbang phyug

drang lung pa rin chen dpal/ kun spangs chos grags/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyang thos so/ /rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i sher phyin dkar mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa yab sras gsum/ chos rje sa paṇa/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan po pa/ bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang man gong bzhin/ rgyal gzhung gnyis sgrub thabs ye shes snang ba bstod pa dang bcas pa/ de dag la dgos pa'i man ngag rnams thos so/ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ mi g.yo ba/ grub thob 'od byed 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dā na shī la/ yon tan khri/ 'dul 'dzin byang seng / rgya tsha lung mang po/ rgya tsha gzhon nu grags/ mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ g.yag mi pham chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen rong ston/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gong bzhin/ yang na paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra gupta/ ā nand+ra ka ra gupta/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa/ paṇḍi ta tā na shi la/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ slob dpon 'u yug pa/ bcom ldan ral gri/ slob dpon bsod nams bzang po/ dar bzang pa/ mkhan chen bsod she/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon po/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje kun bzang / bla ma paṇḍi ta man gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs lhug pa dang / tshigs bcad gnyis/ bstod pa rnams dā na shī las mdzad pa/ leb rgan dar gyi sbyor ba/ bogs 'byin sdigs 'dzub kyi sbyor ba sogs yi ge rnying pa rnams dang / sgrub thabs chos rje g.yag pas mdzad pa thos/ sgrub thabs gnyis kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ dā na shī la/ dge bshes byang chub 'od/ dpal gzhon nu ye shes/ bla ma nyi ma zhabs/ bu ston/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/

chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ seng ge sgra/ tsand+ra go mi/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ a sd+yu la badzra/ bha ro phyag rdum/ mal lo/ /rje sa chen/ gtsug tor rgyal po/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje sa paṇa/ shar pa sher 'byung / ye shes rin chen/ kun dga' byang chub/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang ba/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs tsand+ra go mas mdzad pa mal bsgyur/ rmi lam brtag pa/ gtor chog klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rnams mchan dang bcas pa/ bstod pa ti la ka ka la shās mdzad pa/ bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ gdon grol gyi cho ga dkar shākya grags kyis mdzad pa/ gdung brgyud pa rin rgyal gyis mdzad pa lag len dang bcas pa thos/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / a mo gha badzra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma rin chen dpal/ bla ma byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa/ sbyin sreg rnams 'phags pas mdzad pa thos so/ /spyan ras gzigs dpal mo lugs kyi/ rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ /paṇḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu/ ye shes bzang po/ bal po paṇḍi/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub thob nyin phug pa/ sprul pa rdo rje rgyal po/ zhang ston dgra 'jigs/ rtsi 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ bde ba can pa/ chu bzang pa/ rin po che shes rab 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med/ bla ma buddha shrī/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ dpal mo'i gzhung bzhi yang thos so/ /rta mgrin jo bo lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/

spyan ras gzigs/ mar me mdzad/ yol grub thob/ mtha' bzhi grub thob/ rin po che smon lam pa/ lha ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ byang chub rin chen/ byang chub gzhon nu/ byams pa rin chen/ byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs dang / zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis jo bos mdzad pa thos/ rta mgrin lcags ral can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rta mgrin/ byang sems zla rgyal/ zhang skyi tsha 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar ba/ zhang lo tsā ba/ zhang byang rin/ dpal rgyal ba grub/ chos rje 'dzin pa/ chos rje spang sgang pa/ sgrub pa po rin chen brtson 'grus/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang / nad pa gso ba/ steng gdon gzir ba/ lus srung ba/ ser ba srung ba/ phyir bzlog rnams thos so/ /phyag na rdo rje u tsarya'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ padma badzra/ nā gardzu na/ tsand+ra go mi/ rā dza dha rma/ zang gling pa/ khams pa a seng / zhang ston dkon mchog rgyud smon mkhar ba/ skyi ston ru zhang / dkon mchog blo gros/ chos grags/ e pa mkhon ston/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma rgyal 'od/ slob dpon smra ba'i seng ge/ chos rje byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can klu dang gnod sbyin gdug pa can 'dul ba'i rgyud le'u dgu pa/ rgyud gong ma'i las tshogs/ smyo ba 'dul ba/ bsre'u gso ba/ rims nad bsrung ba/ 'byung po phra mo'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ lto bsrung bya ba/ klu'i dug bsal ba/ klu'i dug rus pa la zhugs pa/ rtsa dang chu bar zhugs pa/ sbyar dug bsrung ba/ dgra bo klu gdol pa can la gtad pa/ grub pa'i rtags yig gtor ma'i las/ gtor ma byin rlabs rnams dang /

phyag na rdo rje gtum po nag po'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ bsre'u bsrung ba/ ser ba bsrung ba/ ser ba dbab pa/ sbyin sreg gtad 'jug tshul/ jag chings/ ltas ngan btang ba/ rdzas kyi bcos thabs kyi bsrung ba/ drag po'i las sbyor rnams dang / sa bzang 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge gnyis kyang thos/ sa skya pa'i dmar po skor gsum du grags pa la/ rje btsun ma ku ru kulle'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ ku ru kulle/ rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje pa/ 'u yug pa/ kun bsod/ nyi thog pa kun smon/ yon tan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs lhan skyes sgeg pas mdzad pa/ lo rgyus rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bcas pa btsun pa ā nandas mdzad pa/ nus pa mi nyams par khams gsum dbang du bya ba/ yaṃ yig gi man ngag lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa sgrub thabs ma taṃ gis mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen bsgrub sgrub thabs/ man ngag chen po lnga slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ sngags rings/ gtor chog singha dhwa dzas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg ḍoṃ bi he ru ka dang chos rje shar pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba la sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa gsang sgrub rnams thos/ kag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje gdan pa/ sd+ya bi ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ lcags thang pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ khang bsod nams 'bum/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/

sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor los snod bcud dbang du bya ba rin chen rdo rje mdzad pa sd+ya bi ra dang / ba ri bas bsgyur/ 'grel pa rdo rje myu gu sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ dbang sdud kyi man ngag sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ rab gnas kyi zhal gdams/ rā dza la sogs pa dbang du bya ba/ pho mo gnad kyi 'khor lo/ /spogs chog gzhan dbang du bya ba/ nyin srung mtshan srung / sngags kyi dngos grub chud mi za bar byed pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gdams pa/ tsakra bri ba'i man ngag zhal gdams zin bris/ gsang sgrub/ rin chen sgrub pa/ rin po che sgrub pa'i man ngag sbyin sreg bstod pa/ rtags kyi yig chung / tha mo che'i 'khor lo bri thabs/ sgrub thabs bstod pa gnyis rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa rnams thos/ tshogs bdag dmar chen gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ /sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ri khrod mgon po/ ha ngu dkar po/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje pa/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rong pa shes rab seng ge/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang / byang seng ba/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ tshogs bdag gi lo rgyus/ tshogs bdag gi snying po/ puṇya shrī bha dras bsgyur ba/ sgrub thabs dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa lha chen gyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs rje btsun pas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg bstod pa/ sgrub thabs yi ge rnams 'phags pas mdzad pa/ bstod pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa rnams kyang thos/ gzhan 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i skor gyi yig cha 'ga' thos kyang / thos yig dkyus la 'bri ba'i srol med ces gsung bas ma bris so/ /don yod zhags pa dpa' gcig gi rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ shī la ā ka ra/ bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/

/rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ gtsang so zho ra ba/ la ru ba bsod nams seng ge/ grags chen/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje btsun kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ rje bsod nams lhun 'grub/ des bdag la'o/ /don zhags kyi rgyud chung ba ri bas bsgyur/ gso sbyong rang blang gi cho ga rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams thos so/ /don zhags lha lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ e ra pa ti/ rigs ngan rnam 'byor ma/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun lho pa/ zhang nyin phug pa/ yang na thugs rje chen po/ dharma ka pā la/ bsod snyoms pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ gnub ston phag lung ba/ nyin phug pa/ yang na thugs rje chen po/ shī la ā ka ra/ bai ro tsā na/ ba ri ba/ mkhan thang pa/ nyin phug pa/ yang na/ 'phags pa/ dā byang sems/ shrī dā na/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ nyin phug pa/ de man chad mthun par/ drang po lung pa/ mnga' ris bde mdzes/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal grub/ 'jim pa/ chos rje gangs khrod pa/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /bka' babs bzhir grags so/ /dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srungs rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang lan lnga'i bar du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shradhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā/ rje btsun sa skya pa/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/

chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis ka la/ rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub kyis gsan/ de la bdag dpal sa skya lo tsā bas zhus so/ /thun mong ma yin pa lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang lan gsum thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ padma 'byung gnas/ paṇḍi ta dharma pā la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ /rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan man sngar bzhin/ mgon po'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shrad dhā ka ra warma dang / lo chen rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/ yang sgrub thabs de nyid paṇḍi ta rin chen rdo rje dang / ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur/ yang rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las phyung ba/ lcam dral gyi rtsa sngags ma ti paṇa chen gyis bsgyur ba/ dpang lo tsā bas zhus dag mdzad pa'i rtsa sngags/ chos rje rdo rje'i 'chang chen po yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i sngags don bshad pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa sngags kyi them yig shin tu gces pa'i shog bu drug 'di rje btsun gyis mdzad pa yin zer yang / 'phags pa'i bu chen dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa yin gsung / srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi zhal shes mal gyi sgrub yig chen mo ni/ spyir gur gyi mgon po'i bsgrub tshul la yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa dang ma 'brel bar sgrub pa las tshogs bdag gi tshul gyis sgrub pa dang / 'brel bar sgrub pa bka' stod kyi tshul gyis sgrub pa gnyis dang / bsgrub bya lha'i dbang gis rkyang sgrub dang / sbags sgrub gnyis su bsgyur la/ de dag gi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bris pa sgrub yig chen mo zhes grags pa'i bzhugs lugs ni 'ga' zhig tu thor bur byas nas go rim cher mi snang yang /

'dir thog mar lo rgyus zur tsam dang bcas pa'i tshogs bdag gi tshul du sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge gcig ser ba dbab pa'i las kyang yod/ bka' stod kyi tshul du sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge gcig las byang gi yi ge gcig pho rkyang du sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyis yi ge gcig pho rkyang du sgrub pa'i yi ge mes gdung ba'i yig chung gcig ling ka la dgug zhugs sogs bya tshul gyi yi ge gcig sngon tshe ma/ pho nya ma/ srid gsum ma sogs dang / phrin las gzhol ba'i tshig rnams byed lugs kyi yi ge gcig bsnyen sgrub skabs kyi gnad cung zad smos pa'i yig chung gcig rnams dang / de nas sbags sgrub kyi yi ge 'byung ste/ de'ang yab yum gyi tshul du sgrub pa dang / lcam dral gyi tshul du sgrub pa'o/ /phyi ma 'di la gtso 'khor sbags sgrub kyang zer/ gtso 'khor sbags sgrub 'di la gsum ste/ phyi rdzas dang / longs spyod bsrung ba dang / nang las kyi dngos grub sgrub pa dang / gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i 'khu bzlog spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te sems can bsrung ba dang / bang mdzod bsrung ba'o/ /nang las kyi dngos grub sgrub pa la bzhi ste/ myur bar 'dod pa'i las rtsub pa dang brdos te las la sbyar bas zla ba phyed kyi rtsal chen rdzogs pa dang / 'jam zhing zhi ba'i las la yun bsrings te bsgrub pa dang / shin tu myur ba'i las la zhag bdun gyi rtsal chen rdzogs pa dang / rgyun du brten pa'i las la zhi drag phyed mas sgrub pa'o/ /de dag re re la yang bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor gsum gsum thob po/ /gsum pa gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog spang ba ni/ lha'i gnad/ sngags kyi gnad/ rdzas kyi gnad/ go bzlog pa'i gnad/ las mkhan yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i gnad de lnga'o/ /rtsub lugs kyi sgrub pa thams cad kyi cha rkyen du dgos pa 'khor lo'i rab gnas kyi yi ge dang /

dam shing la dbang bskur lugs rnams kyang 'di dag dang 'brel chags su bris yod do/ /thams cad kyi gsham na dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo 'di nag po chen po nyid kyi bram ze mchog sred la ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul phyin ci ma log par bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan nas gsal zhing dag par bgyis pa rdzogs so/ /zhes pa yod do/ /bzhugs lugs 'di ni chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi phyag dpe las bris pa'i sgrub yig rnams na 'dug pa ltar go rim byas pa yin no/ /lha brgyad sbags te sgrub pa la/ sgrub lugs du ma yod kyang gcig tu bgrangs la rab gnas dang dam shing la dbang bskur ba tha dad du bgrangs shing snga ma rnams don tshan mi gcig pas so sor bgrangs so/ /yongs dum bu bcu gnyis byas pa 'di'i lugs la yod do/ /zur na yod pa'i yig rnying la 'jam zhing zhi ba'i skabs kyi rten bca' ba bsnyen sgrub sbags ma las sbyar te gsum gril ba'i yi ge gcig 'di'i 'og na yang gsum ste rten bca' ba sogs dang 'jam zhing zhi ba'i lugs rdzogs so zhes pa yod/ bod rbad bsad gsum gril nas bzla tshul/ rbad pa la thun sngags 'dogs lugs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sngags bzlas thabs zor 'phang thabs rnams zur tsam smos pa'i yig chung gcig bod rbad bsad gsum gril zhes nas bshags pa mang du byas la zor 'phangs so zhes pa'i bar ro/ /myur ba'i las kyi skabs su rten bca' ba/ rdzas dgram pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum rnams ston cing / gtso bor lha mo la grogs skal du gtad pa'i yi ge gcig spyir 'di la gnyis las zhes pa nas dkyil 'khor la brten pa rtsub lugs su sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i bar ro/ /shin tu rtsub pa'i sgrub lugs kyi yi ge sgrub yig chen mo'i nang na yod pa las cung zad rgyas pa gcig rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang bskyed pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor sogs mi dgos zhes pa nas lam rgya gram la sogs par mnan no'i bar/

sgrub pa'i skabs su rten yod med gnyis las yod pa'i lugs ltar sgrub pa'i yig chung gcig dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dus su ces pa nas sgrub pa'i lugs de gsum ka la mthun pa'i grogs mang na las myur ro'i bar ro/ /bsad pa'i 'chor stabs med pa'i man ngag bdun gyi grangs tsam ston pa'i yig chung gcig 'di la bsad pa ces pa nas mnan pa gsum ni las kyi mjug sdud yin no'i bar ro/ /lha dang bral ba'i phyag gi gnad kyi yig chung shin tu zab pa gcig lha dang dbral ba ni zhes nas srung ba rnams kyi ma thub pa yin no'i bar ro/ /bsad las skabs kyi rten gyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar bri ba/ bskyed pa rten gyi 'khor lo ji ltar bca' ba/ bsad pa las kyi 'khor lo drug dang phur bu ji ltar 'god pa/ dam rdzas dang mchod rten sogs ji ltar bsham thabs/ bsad pa las khung gi rdzas dang rten bshams pa ting nge 'dzin sngags kyi bzlas thabs te bdun po zur tsam ston pa'i yig chung gcig chos skyong lcam dral gyis zhes pa nas bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o bar ro/ /pho mo bsgrub pa'i gnad dang / zor bsgrub pa/ mnan pas bsgrub pa/ lha rtags dang / rmi rtags sogs 'byung lugs dang gnad lnga'i byed lugs sogs zhib tu ston pa'i yi ge gcig 'di la spyir pho sgrub sngon du ma song ba zhes pa nas dam chig la sel med pa dang 'cham dam pa shin tu gces zhes pa'i bar ro/ rtsub pa'i zur 'debs ma mo la grogs maṇḍal zur drug tsakra pri zhes nas mnan pa bya ba'i bar ro skal du gtad pa gcig mkha' 'gro'i 'khu bzlog spang ba'i skabs su gnad lnga byed lugs kyi yig chung gcig drag po las kyi sbyor ba zhes nas gnad 'di shin tu gces pas dam por bzung ngo'i bar ro/ /pho lha/ dgra lha/ srog lha/ mo lha yul lha sogs dang 'byed lugs kyi yig chung gcig lha dang dgra bo zhes nas 'di cho gas dbral ba ste zhes pa'i bar ro/

/lo rgyus kyi yi ge bcu gcig spyir 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhes nas sa skya pa yab sras la'o zhes pa'i bar ro/ /ma hā kā la'i cho 'phrul gyi skrag cing dngangs bar byed pa'i yig chung gcig go oṃ shrī ma hā kā la na mo zhes nas bskul bar bya ba'i bar ro/ /yongs bcu bzhi mchis so/ /gtso 'khor sbags sgrub lo chen gyi mdzad gsung ba de nyid sgrub yig chen mo'i gsham du bris pa gnang la/ sgrub lugs bzhi yod pa'i zhi ba'i sgrub lugs sogs gsum dang / gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i 'khu bzlog spang ba 'khor lo'i rab gnas sam shing la dbang bskur ba rnams yi ge 'ga' zhig na logs su bris yod kyang sgrub yig chen mo'i nang nas yod pa dang zhus dag pher ro/ /sgrub yig chen mo'i bzhugs lugs kyi rim pa ni gong na gsal/ 'di dag man ngag snying po'i skor rang gi thob pa tsam gyi tho bsgrigs pa yin gyi gzhan kun gyi grangs ni yun ring du bla ma mkhas pa la mnyan nas shes dgos kyi yi ge mthong ba la pho tshod dang / rang dga' byas bas tshud za bar 'gyur ro/ /shes na chos kun yid bde'i ltad mo yin/ /mi shes sdug bsngal 'khor lo rgyun du 'bab/ /zab mo ston pa'i gdams pa bla ma las/ /dges bzhin thos pa skal bzang dpal 'byor yin/ /'di la ltos nas gdams pa zab mo tshol/ /lto chos wa zegs bsdus pas sangs rgyas min/ /nyams len grub thob rnams kyi rjes su snyogs/ /rtogs pa tshad du skyel ba nang nas 'char/ gong gi mal gyi sbags sgrub chen mo nas 'di'i bar rje nyid kyi dkar chag gsan yig gi tshul du mdzad pa yin zhing 'di'i lung yang mnos/ /brgyud pa bzang ldan nam/ pho rkyang du bsgrub pa bsnyen bsgrub las gsum gyi sgrub thabs 'di rje btsun gyi mdzad pa yin nges so zhes gsungs/ yang pho rkyang du bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub thabs puṇya badzra gyis mdzad pa/ gnyan phul byung ba gtsug tor rgyal po/

'dzin gtor bca' thabs/ mnan pa'i thun sgrub/ mnan pa dngos/ yang rten gtor bca' thabs tshigs bcad ma/ dzñā na nā tha dang / byang chub shing gi rgyu mtshan sgrub pa dang / las la sbyor tshul gsang rten lus la bcang ba/ 'khor lo 'bri tshul/ lha brgyad kyi sbags sgrub chos rje gzungs kyi dpal bzang pos 'di'i 'go na bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ chos skyong lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /bsgrub pa mdor bsdus 'bri bar bya/ /ces mchod pa brjod pa yod de mdzad pa/ de'i gnad dril ba de nyid kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sbags sgrub/ lcam dral gyi rjes gnang / gtor ma'i cho ga bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ bshags pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa gang sku ma/ zhal bzhi pa'i bstod pa sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus ma/ lcam dral gyi rjes gnang byed tshul/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang byed tshul/ pu tra'i bsgrub yig gter ma/ mo rkyang gi rgya gzhung lo ka shrīs bsgyur ba/ lha mo'i gzungs/ mo rkyang gi bsgrub lugs dge slong puṇya badzra gyis mdzad pa/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos mdzad pa'i las byang la/ rje btsun gyis zhus dag mdzad pa/ ma hā kā li'i gtor ma sogs kyi/ zhal gdams nag po zhabs kyis mdzad zhes pa 'byung ste min gsungs/ 'khor lo'i 'bri yig rnying ma/ ngag mnan byed tshul/ sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur ba'i man ngag mgon po'i 'bri yig 'phags pa rin po ches gsung bzhin dam pa mdzad pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i lcam dral gyi rjes gnang byed tshul/ yang rjes gnang gi zhal gdams brag phug pas mdzad pa/ las mkhan mon bu pho mo'i sgrub yig brgyud pa bzang ldan ma che ba dam pas mdzad pa/ las mgon zangs gri can gyi sgrub thabs bskul dang bcas pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs/

lcam dral sbags sgrub kun dga' dpal gyis mdzad pa/ nag po chen po la bka' bsgo ba'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa dang / ye shes kyi mgon po zangs gri can 'khor bcas kyi gsang sgrub las la sbyar ba'i lag len/ yang bsnyen sgrub rbad bsad gsum gyi lag len/ sngags bzlog nag po chen po pho rkyang du bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ mo rkyang du bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin pho mo rnams kyi bstod pa dang bcas pa rnams dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa brtag gtor gyi yig rnying man ngag ces bya ba/ rten gtor sogs bca' thabs de'i lag len gyi zin bris rje nyid kyis mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ dam pas mdzad pa'i bskang bshags che chung gnyis/ chos kyi rje kun dga' dbang phyug pas bsgrigs pa'i bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho/ aṣṭa la brten nas gzhan gyi byad bzlog byed tshul/ rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa de nyid kyi mchan dang bcas pa'i lung thob/ bha ya na'i byad bzlog rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa la/ rje btsun rtse mo'i mchan gyi steng nas sgom lung thob nas bsnyen pa'i zhal shes ma dhā paṇṇi tas mdzad pa/ sbyin srig gi zhal shes rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ khro bcu'i srung 'khor rgyas pa'i 'bri yig rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ bha ya na la sngags mchan chos rje paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ mgon po'i lder sku bzhengs tshul gyi gsal byed yig chung rje bla ma dam pa nyid kyis mdzad pa/ mgon po'i lder sku bzhengs tshul 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi gsang sgrubs pu gri skor gsum/ dur khrod nag po'i rgyud/ sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ga rod kyis bsgyur/ lcam dral gyi sbyin sreg dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa/ zor gyi las 'di'i 'og na nya gsum la zor gyis bsad pa byed pa'i zor sgrub pa ces pa dang /

gsham na zor las 'di rkyang pa dang sbrags ma gnyis ka'i thun mong ba yin ces pa yod/ 'jam zhing zhi 'di la gnyis las 'jam zhing zhi bas bsgrub par 'dod na gsum ste gsham ni dkyil 'khor la brten nas 'jam par bsgrub pa sogs yod ba'i bsgrub pa/ phur pa lha mor byin rlabs byed tshul phreng phyed dang gnyis/ 'khor lo dang phur bu yod med kyi bya tshul phreng gcig pho rkyang du bsgrub pa/ mo rkyang du bsgrub pa/ 'di'i gsham na mo rkyang du bsgrub pa'o ces pa yod/ de'i 'phro la rang gi snying kha na khro bo zhags pa dang lcags kyu dang rlung thogs pa spros pa la sogs dang / sngon tshe ma dang / dpal ldan mgon po sogs phrin las 'chol tshul dang / skabs su dpal ldan mgon po zhes dang / mon bu pu tra gnas nas bskyod zhes sogs phrin las 'chol tshul rnams so/ /de gnyis kyi thun mong ba/ mes gdung pa'i las sbyor phreng gsum bsnyen sgrub skabs su ji ltar bya tshul phreng bzhi mgon po phur bu'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ mgon po'i 'khor lo'i 'bri 'og na mgon po'i 'khor lo lte ba myur bcas pa'i zhes pa dang mjug na rten 'brel snying po me tog dor ba tsam gyi rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro zhes pa yod do tshul gyi gsal byed/ ser ba dbab de nas man ngag bshad pa la zhes dang mjug tu ser ba dbab pa ces pa yod pa dang / pra dbab pra dbab par 'dod pas zhes dang bu mo dag la dri bar bya zhes pa yod pa/ ltas ngan dbab drag hi zhes pa nas sngags yin zhes pa'i bar ro pa'i sngags/ 'dzin gtor gyi man ngag 'dzin gtor gyi man ngag la dbang bskur rab tu gnas zhes pa nas 'dzin gtor gyi man ngag shin tu zab bo ces pa'i bar ro rnams yig rnying / rten gtor gyi man ngag dang / mgon po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum gnyis paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa rnams thob bo/

/yang rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i yig skor gyi lung thob pa la/ lo rgyus/ rjes gnang / rwa zor/ rtsa ba'i 'khor lo/ /rab gnas/ gnad 'bebs sgong zor/ kha sbyor dbye ba/ sngags ring / sngags kyi them yig sngags gi gnad g.yab pa dar thogs/ nor sgrub/ dbang bsdud/ spos sbyor/ rang dang slob ma rdzas sogs gtad pa/ gtsug lag khang sogs gtad pa/ gnas mal dang nor rdzas bsrung ba/ bsangs byed kyi cho ga bskang bshags/ spyod lam dang dbang du bya ba/ de'i gnad/ dam tshig gso ba/ zhal gdams pa don drug ma/ rten bca' thabs/ chos skyong bsten thabs/ rten gzugs/ yang rten gyi man ngag sngags ring thung gi man ngag bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ sbyin sreg ma nyan na tshod lta byed lugs/ dmod bskul/ 'go ba'i thabs/ 'khon nag zas su za ba/ bskyod/ mnan/ bsrung thabs/ ltas ngan gtong thabs/ gnyan gyi shog dril chig brgyud ma/ bskrad chog sri'u gso ba/ shwa bzlog bskang ba bsdus pa/ bstod pa gnyan gyis mdzad pa/ yang ltas ngan gtong thabs/ rbad pa'i gdams pa/ 'gab 'dre mnan pa/ rakṣi ta'i man ngag kha'u ba'i bstod pa/ sgrub dus kyi gdams pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams rnams thob/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mgon po/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dus zhabs pa che chung / rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ dpal chen rga lo/ phag mo gru pa/ 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po/ skyi shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ skyi shod pa grags pa seng ge/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ bla ma paṇḍi ta/ rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na lo tsā ba/ sprul sku nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' rtse mo/ /bla ma paṇa chen man sngar bzhin no/ /yang ye shes mgon po de nyid kyi gsang sgrub srog gi thig le'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ ke sa ra na te/ dril bu pa/ dza landha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ a wa dhū ti pa/ kha che byang chub bzang po/ dga' ba'i rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ /phag mo gru pa/ rgya kun mkhyen/ gtsang drag pa rin chen gzhon nu/ rin chen grags/ rin chen smon lam/ bla chen smon lam shes rab/ sgra tshad pa blo chen/ mnyam med lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ sprul sku nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' rtse mo/ /paṇa chen grags rgyal/ rje bsod nams lhun grub/ de la bdag gi thob/ mngon rtogs srog gi thig le/ bsnyen pa srog thig bsgrub pa srog thig las sbyor srog thig gsang sgrub srog thig yang gsang srog gi thig le/ gtor ma'i man ngag lag len du bkod pa/ nang sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum dang bcas pa/ seng gdong dbang chog phan bya gser gyi phreng ba/ gnod bya btsan dug gi phreng ba/ chings lo rgyus/ rtags yig mdos byang / gsang sgrub rtsa ba klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rtsa mis bsgyur/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge/ gtor chog bskang ba/ mnga' gsol/ gtor ma la brten nas dgra bo tshar bcad pa'i tshul/ bsrung bzlog gi yi ge/ bstod 'bum rnams rje paṇḍi tas bsgrigs pa'i lung / mgon po dkar po'i tshe sgrub byed tshul/ mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud las phyung ba lag len dang bcas pa thob/ khyung khra'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rgyal po zla ba bzang po/ rgyal po grags pa/ dus 'khor ba che chung / ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/

chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje paṇḍi ta man gong bzhin/ phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs dang rnam thos sras ser chen gyi rjes gnang phyogs gcig tu thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ g.yor po jo ston/ pur bsod nams rin chen/ bla ma 'byin phu ba/ lha rje jo bzang po/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bla ma 'bri lung pa/ rin po che bsod nams seng ge/ ka bzhi ba grags gzhon/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ de gnyis ka la jo nang phyogs rgyal/ de nas chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rnam sras kyi sgrub thabs 'gro bzang gi rtog pa/ bde byed kyi rtog pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ te tsa de wa dang / 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i man ngag 'gro bzang gis mdzad pa zangs dkar gyis bsgyur/ rnam sras kyi bus rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i man ngag 'gro bzang gis mdzad pa gzi brjid lha dang zangs dkar gyis bsgyur/ sngags gud na gab pa/ rang byin rlabs dngos la brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba bsnyen pa'i yi ge zangs dkar gyis mdzad pa/ snyan grags bsgrub pa/ gdul bya'i snying bsgul ba/ tshe bsgrub pa/ dgra srog myur du bcad pa/ dgos 'dod dkor mdzod bsgrub pa/ shes tu gces pa'i shol ril drug zangs dkar gyi sro ma mgul khug che chung gnyis/ phyag mtshan dang po rgyal mtshan gyis bar chad bsal ba/ ne'u le la brten te zas nor bsgrub pa/ dzambha la'i bī dza pu ka ra la brten te skye bo dbang du bsdu ba/ ne'u le la brten nas zas nor bsgrub pa/ gang ba bzang pos dmag dpung bzlog pa/ nor bu bzang pos nor bsgrub pa/

ku be ras chom rkun bcing ba/ yang dag shes kyi mngon shes dang dbang phyug bsgrub pa/ 'brog gnas kyi dgra bo bsad pa/ lnga brtsen gyi tshe bsgrub pa/ tsi pi kuṇḍa lis chu 'khyags bsrung ba rnams bi ka ma la pu ri dang / bikṣa ta de ba dang / snubs lo tsā ba byams pa dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba/ rnam sras drag byed ma'i cho ga 'gro bzang gis mdzad pa/ rnam sras kyi bstod pa thugs rje'i ba 'jo bar grags pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khro phu ba yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ dge slong byang chub dpal bzang po/ rin po che bsod nams grags/ 'dren mchog phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rnam sras zhi drag gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ g.yor po jo ston/ pur bsod nams rin chen/ 'byid phu ba padma bkra shis/ rtag pa jo bzang / lo tsā ba byams pa dpal/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug rin po che khro phu ba/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin po che/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bstod chen rgyal po'i thugs rab tu mnyes byed/ zhi drag gi rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i zhal shes lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa thos so/ /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi bsgom lung zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/

kun bsod/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /sgrub thabs dang las tshogs kyi yi ge rnying pa mdzad byang med pa thos so/ /rme brtsegs dud kha'i sgrub thabs dang / las tshogs kyi yi ge chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bsgom lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ gra thang pa/ bla ma kun bsod/ bla ma blo gros dpal/ dge bshes seng ge/ mkhan po bsod she ba/ mkhan po sher mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ klu dbang rgyal po'i sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rin bzang gis bsgyur dang / sgrub thabs bcom ral gyis mdzad pa gnyis thob/ gnyis pa rgyud kyi bshad bka' dang / man ngag dang lung sna tshogs ji ltar thos pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa la/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i mchan dang / sngon 'gro rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing / gzhung don la rnam bshad dag ldan gyi steng nas man ngag gi bshad pa shin tu zhib la mtha' chod par gnang zhing / 'di dus tshul bzhi'i gsal byed kyi yig cha yang gsungs las zin pa rnams brjed tho'i tshul du btab pa/ rjes su chos rje nyid kyi sku drung du gzigs phul zhus dag mdzad nas mchod brjod dang rtsams byang kyang sbyar ba sogs kyi sgo nas legs par thob pa'i man ngag lugs kyi ring brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ bla ma chen po 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ se ston kun rig zhang ston chos 'bar/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/

slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgya mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ bla ma brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / bla ma blo gros brtan pa gnyis ka la/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pas gsan/ de la chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ de la chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa dang / paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gsan/ de gnyis ka la rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsan/ des bdag lo tsā ba la'o/ /yang na/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa man gong bzhin no/ /nye brgyud ni rje btsun chen pos/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bsgo/ /de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs/ /blo ldan don 'di shes na smra bar bgyi/ ces sogs shlau ka bzhi'i don 'chad tshul la mi gcig pa mang du 'dug na'ang / 'dir ni rgyud sde spyi rnam kyi gsal byed rje nyid kyi gsung las 'byung ba nang bzhin brgyud pa'i rim pa dngos/ rgyud kyi 'chad thabs/ de gzhan las khyad par 'phags tshul/ dge rtsa bsngo ba gzhir byas nas bshad pa ltar na/ rig byed ste sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang / lag pa ste rdo rje bdag med ma/ me ste rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ chu gter te sa skya pa chen po la/ des 'byung ba ste/ rje btsun sku mched la babs shing / de nas sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa nas zhang dkon mchog dpal man sngar dang 'dra'o/ /man ngag lugs gtso che ba'i rgyud sde spyi rnam chung ngu / ṭīka chung man ngag don gsal/ rgyud sde'i dum bu brgya dang bcu gsum pa dang / brgya lnga cu pa gnyis rnams sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa thos/ yang rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying pos mdzad pa/

dka' 'grel 'khon dge chu ba shākya 'bar gyis mdzad pa/ rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa ste 'grel pa lugs gtso che bar grags pa'i yi ge rnams kyi steng nas bshad lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ ḍoṃ bi he ru ka/ a la la badzra/ nags khrod pa/ garbha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa rgyal ba dpal gyi ye shes/ slob dpon mi thub zla ba/ de la slob ma'i mchog dpa' bo rdo rje/ seng ge rdo rje sgra gcan 'dzin gsum las 'dir dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje/ des 'brog mi lo tsā ba la gnang / de la slob ma'i mchog mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ se mkhar chung pa kun rig 'khying lo tsā ba 'od kyi snang ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po ste bzhi las/ 'dir bla ma mnga' ris pa/ 'khon sgye chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ rjes sa chen/ yang na 'khying lo tsā ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa chen/ yang na 'brog mi/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa chen ste de ltar na gzhung 'grel lugs kyi brgyud pa'i bka' babs gsum/ man ngag lugs dang bcas pa'i bka' babs bzhi dang ldan pa'i bla ma sa skya pa chen po la slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ /zhang tshul khrims grags/ gnyan gtsug tor rgyal po gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum ka la rje btsun grags pa/ de nas sa skya paṇḍi ta man gong bzhin/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad brgyud rdo rje gur gyi rgyud/ ma pang du bu 'chad pa'i tshul gyis rtsa rgyud sbrags pa/ rje btsun rin po che'i mchan bu sa bcad rnam bshad gur rgyan dang bcas pa'i steng na bshad pa yongs rdzogs dang / thun mong gi bshad brgyud dpal saṃ pu ṭa'i rgyud brtag pa dang po la brtag pa bcu/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa la/ sngon du tshul bzhi mdor bsdus mdzad nas/ sa bcad dang / ṭīka gnad kyi gsal byed rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa dang / brtag pa phyi ma la rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i ṭīka chung gnyis rnams kyi steng nas bshad pa tshar gcig dang /
