yang saṃ pu ṭa'i mchan chen rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas tshar gcig rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni gong dang 'dra'o/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud le'u lnga cu rtsa gcig pa mal los bsgyur/ sa skya pa chen po'i gsung bzhin gnyan phul byung bas mdzad pa'i ṭī ka mu tig phreng ba rang mchan dang bcas pa'i steng nas slob bshad kyi tshul du sngags btu'i byin rlabs gnyis 'khor lo rnams kyi lag len sogs zhib par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri/ lū hi pa/ da ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza landha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje/ gu hya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog kya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo blo gros grags/ dpal sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag la'o/ /rtsa rgyud kyi nyung du 'tshams sbyor ru ma ti kī rtis mdzad pa grags 'byor shes rab kyi bsgyur thos/ jo bo a ti sha'i gsung bzhin lo chen rin bzang gis mdzad pa'i dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i bshad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lo chen/ 'al pa ston mgon/ 'al pa jo btsun/ sgom pa mang sgom/ sbal spang sna ba/ me reg dar byang / rin chen rgyal po/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ yang dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa dmar chos rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun pu hrangs pa/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rdo rje/ thub pa shes rab/

brtson 'grus rdo rje/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ bla ma shākya gzhon nu/ lce blo ldan seng ge/ 'phags 'od man gong bzhin/ ma hā mā ya'i rgyud le'u gsum pa a sd+yu la da sa dang 'gos kyis 'gyur la/ zhi ba bzang po dang klog kyas bcos pa/ 'grel pa lho mgar rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i steng nas bshad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / byang sems rdo rje snying po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ ḍoṃ bi ba/ nā ro pa/ bal po zhi ba bzang po/ mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros/ rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ rngog jo sras/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog tsha chos sku/ rngog tsha dkon mchog dpal/ klog kya dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bdun pa/ sa skya pa'i ṭī ka'i steng nas bshad pa thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal 'dzin/ nā ro pa/ a sd+yu la badzra/ bla ma bha ro phyag rdum/ mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun sku mched/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang po/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa rwas 'gyur/ dkar 'grel/ nag 'grel/ bcud thigs rnams kyi steng nas rwa lugs kyi bshad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal/ padma badzra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/

rwa 'bum seng / rje btsun rga lo/ /rong pa sher seng / bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rtog pa gsum pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur dang / de'i 'grel pa rgya ston gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas bshad pa thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra che chung / skyo 'od byung / skyo sku mched/ skyo khams pa/ gnyan rin chen bstan/ gnyan 'od srung / gnyan chos rgyal/ glo chen/ rgyal bzang dpal/ spang sgang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyu/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / tshul khrims rgyal bas 'gyur/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mchan rnams kyi steng nas bshad bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ glo chen man gong bzhin/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud/ mchan dang / sa bcad dang / don gsal gyi steng nas bshad bka' thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor skyangs/ slob dpon kun snying / shes rab skyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad dhā ka ra/ lo chen rin bzang / yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo/ bla ma sa skya pa/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa'i mchod rten sgrub pa lag len dang bcas pa thos so/ /tshe dpag med kyi mdo'i bshad pa slob dpon legs rin gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa yang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rtse mo/ /rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ bkra shis dpal/ brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ byang phug pa legs rin/ bla ma paṇḍi ta man gong bzhin/ bde mchog gi sgrub thabs dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa pu n+ya badzra gyis mdzad pa'i 'bru 'bum gyi steng nas bskyed rim gyi bshad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri/ lū hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza landha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa/ gu hya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ phaṃ thing pa sku mched/ klog kya pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa/ puṇya badzra/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje khu dbon/ zhang pa/ na bza' pa/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta man gong bzhin/ yang sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod kyi gnas su gshegs pa'i bla ma pu hrang lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab nas brgyud pa'i nag 'bum du grags pa'i lung thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ thog mar brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ rim bzhi'i 'khrid rim tshigs bcad ma/ dam tshig phyag rgya sa bcu gnyis pa'i lam khrid/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ yang rim bzhi lam khrid des mdzad pa/ las rgya'i lam khrid/ phyag rgya chen po'i lam khrid gnyis/ dam tshig brgyad pa/ rim bzhi'i nang khrid/ sa bcu gsum gyi nang khrid/ las rgya'i nang khrid/ phyag rgya chen po'i nang khrid/ lam gsum gcig tu bsre pa'i gdams ngag srog rtsol gyi nang khrid/ rlung rdo rje thod sbyor gyi man ngag yang srog rtsol nang khrid gnad drug ma/ rlung 'khor ba 'ching grol gyi man ngag gnyis/

gtum mo don skor bcu drug pa/ srog rtsol gnad 'byed/ yang rlung 'khor ba 'ching grol gyi gdams ngag don skor bcu drug pa'i phyi khrid/ rang lus gtor mar btang thabs/ rim lnga'i gdams ngag rim lnga gdan thog cig tu bsgom pa'i zhal gdams pa/ rim lnga'i nang 'khrid/ las rgya'i lam khrid rgyas pa/ de'i lhan thabs kyi yig chung gsum rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ pu hrangs lo tsā ba/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rdo rje/ thub pa shes rab/ brtson 'grus rdo rje dmar chos rgyal/ shākya gzhon nu/ lce blo ldan seng ge/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur/ rje btsun chen po'i mchan dang bcas pa'i steng nas bshad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor skyangs/ kun dga' snying po/ shes rab skyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shraddha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin bzang / brag steng pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa kun dga' snying po/ gnyag ston dbang rgyal/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' ba/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi bstod pa ba ri bas bsgyur/ sa skya pa gong ma'i mchan/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sa bcad dang bcas pa'i steng nas bshad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ glo chen/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma bram chen po/

sa bzang ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mchog grub ma'i gzungs gzu lo tsā ba dga' ba'i rdo rje'i bsgyur la rje nyid kyi mchan dang / srung bzlog yig chung nyid kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas bshad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ skyu ra a skyabs/ bla ma sa chen/ rje btsun sku mched/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang pa/ na bza' ba/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes snying po/ ye shes zhi ba/ sangs rgyas zhi ba/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku sa li che chung / gser gling pa/ rdo rje dī paṃ ka ra/ go mo sgom chen/ kyi nor dzñā na/ gnyag ldom bu ba/ spug chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bya rin chen 'od/ glo chen/ bde ba can pa/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ gnyis pa grol byed lam gyi skor la/ thog mar gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i nyams khrid dbang byin rlabs lung man ngag sogs legs par thob pa'i dbang la/ kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi phyi dkyil gnyis dang / lam dus/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje bdag med ma/ birwa ba rin chen rdo rje/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi mi bskyed rdo rje/ se mkhar chung pa dwe ṣa badzra/ zhang dgon pa ba la li ta/ sa chen a kṣo bhya badzra/ rtse mo dwe ṣa badzra/ grags pa a kṣo bhya badzra/ sa paṇa la li ta badzra/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod 'di la dpal ldan pas tshar bcu bdun gsan nams pa/

dpal ldan pa/ grub chen buddha shrī akṣo bhya badzra/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug rje legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag la'o/ /bdag med ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sa chen yan chad gong dang 'dra/ de nas ne tse sbal ston/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam pa ra chos shes/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ 'phags pa man gong dang 'dra/ yig brgya'i bzlas lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ aṣṭa'i bzlas lung gzhi bshad/ byad bzlog dang bcas pa thob/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ sa skya pa chen po'i rnam thar des mdzad pa/ yang sa chen gyi bstod pa tshangs dbang ma dang / gang thugs ma gnyis/ rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i sa chen gyi bstod pa gang thugs ma 'debs/ rtse mo'i rnam thar bstod pa khyod nyid dam pa la mchan bu dang bcas pa dang / tshangs spyod ma gnyis rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyi rnam thar sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ mnal lam ma sbal ston gyis mdzad pa/ sa paṇa gyi rnam thar lho ba kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa dang / yang gsung sgros ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i chos rgyal ma chung ba rang mchan dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa'i rnam thar shar pa ye chen pos mdzad pa/ zhang gi rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ brag phug pa'i rnam thar blo brtan pas mdzad pa/ chos rje bla ma'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ dpal ldan pa'i rnam thar sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa/ buddha ba'i rnam thar rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ rje kun dga' bzang po'i rnam thar mus chen dang paṇḍi tas mdzad pa/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar zhib mo rdo rje dmar gyis mdzad pa/ ngo mtshar snang ba bla ma dam pas mdzad pa/ bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar/

bla ma rdor 'dzin ma rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ de'i kha skong shar pas mdzad pa/ kha skong shlau ka gnyis rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rab dkar ma rong pos mdzad pa/ sde snod ma sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa/ dad pa'i rba rlabs ma 'jam dbyangs chos rjes mdzad pa/ sems dpa' chen po'i bstod pa thub bstan ma dang / 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i bstod pa mtha' yas ma bdag chen chu mig pas mdzad pa/ rgyal tshab dam pa'i rnam thar bstod pa/ kun mkhyen gyi rnam thar/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel gyi bstod pa rnams rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung thob/ bla ma lnga bcu pa lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur/ de'i ṭī ka rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i 'grel pa chung ngu sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i uṣṇi ṣa'i gdams pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gnas bzhugs kyi gsol 'debs brag phug pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa/ dze tā ris mdzad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi pa'i phyag rgya bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ ga ya dha ra dang / gyi jos bsgyur/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ lam dus kyi dbang len tshul/ lam 'bras kyi zin bris che chung gnyis/ mus chen gyis mdzad pa/ dmar ma'i zin bris bar ston ma/ lam dus kyi dbang chog yid bzhin nor bu rgyal tshab dam pas mdzad pa/ lus dkyil rtsod spong lta ba ngan sel rdo rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyis dga' ston la springs yig rje rang gi bstod pa mkhyen brtse ma rnams thos/ rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi nang nas tshig nyung la don rgyas pa'i lam 'bras gnyag ma zhal shes kyi/ yig chung 'phros dang bcas pa thob pa la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i lam 'bras glegs bam la rje sa chen bzhugs dus shubs sag ri yod pas sag shubs ma zer/ rje btsun sku mched kyi dus na bza' dar ser pos dril bas pod ser ma zer zhes nyi ma 'od zer gsung tshig rkang / de'i bsdus don/ 'grel pa/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud gdan sogs/

lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ bum dbang gi 'da' ka ma'i skabs su/ 'chi bltas/ 'khrul 'khor/ 'chi bslu dang bcas pa/ bum dbang gi snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' ka ma/ gsang dbang gi skabs su thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ dbang bzhi pa'i 'da' ka ma bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa/ bar do bzhi'i gdams ngag lam dus kyi dbang / tshad ma bzhi/ gdams ngag drug rten 'brel lnga/ grib sel gyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa/ grib ma khrus kyis sel ba dang / tsha tshas sel ba/ thig le bsrung ba/ yi ge brgya pa'i 'don thabs/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi skabs su rlung gi sbyor ba bdun gyis lam khrid pa/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi/ 'das pa'i lam la/ gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i skabs su dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed kyi mngon rtogs/ de thams cad kyi don bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / de dag la 'phros pa la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'phros nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtsa 'grel gnyis/ gdan sogs la 'phros nas dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba ste/ de la dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa'i man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten te bskur ba/ lam sogs nyi shu la 'phros nas/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus/ dam tshig la 'phros nas bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ srung ba sum cu dang / man ngag gi gnad bdun cu la 'phros nas gegs gsal lo/ /de la yi ge bzhi ste/ bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ byung rgyal du mi btang ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis bsal ba/ rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gcig las dang po pa dang thun mong gi chos bdun mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring / yul gyi mngon rtogs/ dbang chu/

spyin sreg tshogs 'khor/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / lam rgyas pa/ rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bring po/ rang gi gzhung cung zad yod pa bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa ste/ de ltar na rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / lam de dag rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang zhing / rtogs tshad bskyed pa'i phyir/ lam gyi gzhung shing bzhi dang / rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga yod de/ gzhung shing chen po bzhi ni/ gang zag gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhung shing / man ngag gi gnad drug gi bkri ba'i gzhung shing / brtson 'grus can man ngag gi gnad bcu gcig bkri ba'i gzhung shing / gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum du bkri ba'i gzhung shing ngo / /rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga ni/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ lam bsre ba/ phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis so/ /rtogs pa bskyed pa'i dpe chung la/ 'chi bltas kyi 'khor lo gnyis/ rtsa'i dpe chung / bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i dpe chung / rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dpe chung / gegs sel gzhan gyi dpe chung gnyis rnams ni/ gang zag tha ma'i lam yin la/ 'bring gi lam dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ de dag gi gseb tshags su 'du'o/ /gang zag rab kyi lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge/ de thams cad kyi rgyab rten du lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ zhib tu sbyar ba/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba rnams thob bo/ /bir srungs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang / rgyal tshab dam pa/ rje bsod nams lhun grub/ de bdag la'o/ /'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i bir srungs kyi yi ge/ rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bir srungs bar chad kun sel/

sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bir srungs kyi byin rlabs bya tshul/ nyams su len tshul/ man ngag 'di dang lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag mtshon bya mtshon byed du sbyar ba rnams thob/ bir srungs gsar ma'i brgyud pa ni/ birwa pa/ rnal 'byor pa dza doṇa badzra/ grub chen buddha shrī man gong bzhin/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ /rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ buddha shrī man gong bzhin/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge chen mo/ /yang sa paṇa gyis gug shrī jo 'bum gyi don du mdzad pa/ gang drin ma/ sku'i spyod pa rnam dag ma/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i rim pa dang / bla ma la brten nas dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor chos rje bla mas mdzad pa/ rje sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge/ slob dpon yon tan 'od zer gyi mdzad pa'i ngag 'don ma/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad gsung sgros ma dmar mar grags pa rnams thos so/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan rim pa bzhi dang / sambu ṭa'i rgyud kyi brtag pa drug pa las 'byung ba'i/ dpyid kyi thig le'i brgyud pa ni/ badzra dharm+ma rdo rje chos/ badzra pā ṇi phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha mda' 'dzin/ nā gārdzu na klu sgrub/ sha wa ra ri khrod pa/ lū hi pa nya lto pa/ dā ri ka smad 'tshong ma'i khyo/ badzra ghaṇḍa pa rdo rje dril bu pa/ kūrma pā da rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza landha ra dbal 'bar ba 'dzin/

kṛṣṇa tsārya badzra nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje/ gu hya pa gsang ba pa/ bi dza ya pā rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs/ antar pa bar ma/ ti lo pa til brdungs pa/ nā ro pa 'di bram ze'i rigs kyi ming yin/ a bha ya kīrti 'jigs med grags pa/ kā la tsakra dus 'khor ba/ pradzñā ku ṭa shes rab brtsegs/ ma ti kīdhi blo gros grags shrī ma hā bhū mi puṇyā ā nandā garbha dpal sa skya pa che po kun dga' snying po/ ā tsārya ratna puṇyā gra slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ /bhattā ra ka ratna kīrti dhwa dza rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bhū mi puṇyā paṇḍi ta nanda dhwa dza shrī bha dra/ sa skya pa mkhas pa paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ārya ma ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ratna shrī/ dkon mchog dpal/ puṇya shrī/ bsod nams dpal/ sadgu ru pu ṇya dhwa dza shrī bha dra/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ shrī bān shī la/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ dharm+ma swa mi dzñā na dhwa na dhwa dza shrā bha dra/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ badzra dha rā nanda bha dra/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ pañtsa bi dyā kīrti dhwa dza/ lnga rigs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ma ho pā dhyā ya sarba dzñā pu ṇyi ni rā bho ga su bhā ka ra dhwa dza shrī bha dra/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bhū mi puṇya lo tsā mañdzu gho ṣa nanda pu ṇya gīrti dhwa dza shrī bha tre ṇa shru ti/ sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyas mtshan dpal bzang pos thos so/ /rim bzhi lam slongs sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa rang mchan dang bcas pa/

sa skya pa'i nag 'bum du grags pa/ rje sa chen dang rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i bde mchog nag po pa'i yig skor gang yod/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs sgrub pa'i thabs kyi snying po/ dkyil chog gi sdom tshig sbyin sreg lag len dang bcas pa/ rim bzhi'i khrid kyi zur 'debs/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi gsal byed/ byin rlabs drug skor gyi yig chung rnams rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub nyid kyis mdzad pa/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ de'i lhan thabs chung du rje nyid kyis mdzad pa rnams thos/ yang rnal 'byor rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed pa'i man ngag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sbyar ba'i khrid legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍoṃ bi pa/ antar pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ phaṃ thing pa sku mched/ klog kya ba/ mal lo/ /bla ma sa skya pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ yang bde mchog dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs/ dbang chog rim lnga'i gzhung gsum rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ lus dkyil gyi lung sbyor rgyas pa paṇḍi tas mdzad pa lung sbyor chung ba rje nyid kyis mdzad pa yang thos/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim mtshan ma gyen bsgreng / rwa la sems bzung ba/ mtshan mo rgyu ba gsum thob nas brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ 'jam dpal gshin rje/ a mo gha badzra che chung / skyo 'od byung / skyo sku mched/ skyo jo sras khams pa/ gnyan rin chen bstan/ de'i sras gnyan 'od srungs/ gnyan chos rgyal/ 'jim pa rin she/ e pa mkhon ston/

bzhi thog pa 'jam dbyangs/ bla ma cha gan/ klog kya grags chen/ kun mkhyen gang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ khrid yig rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bzhin tsha ba rong pa shākya rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed bskyed rim gyi bshad pa smra ngan kun 'joms slob dpon dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dang / yang bskyed rim gyi bshad pa mus chen gyis mdzad pa gnyis thos/ ḍoṃ bi he rū ka'i byin rlabs/ nyin srungs mtshan srungs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ḍoṃ bi wa/ a la la badzra/ nags khrod pa/ garbha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ durya tsand+ra/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar pa/ zhang pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ paṇḍi ta shes rab/ bsod nams 'bum/ bag ston/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rten 'brel gyi srung ba'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ gnyis spangs pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ se zhang / sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ dkar shākya grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma/ blo gros brtan pa/ de gnyis la dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rten 'brel gyi mdo che ba/ byin rlabs kyi tho yig sa skya pas mdzad pa thos/ chos rje 'jig rten gsum na brnyes pa mi mnga' ba'i 'gro ba'i mgon po rgyal ba yang dgon pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i ri chos thob pa la/ thog mar/ ri chos glad don/ khog phubs rin chen ldan kyis byas pa/ phyi'i rnam thar chen po sgom rin gyis mdzad pa/ nang gi rnam thar 'da' kha zhal chems/

gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa yang dgon pa rang gis mdzad pa/ hūm̐ chos kyi gdams pa/ gsung gi tha ma'i bcud/ byang chub seng ges yi ger bkod pa/ ri chos yon tan kun 'byung rin po che/ 'bar ba/ de'i bar skabs kyi lhan thabs kyi rnam grangs la mchod brjod/ glad don/ rdo rje theg pa'i bsgrub rgyud/ lus rten/ sa gan/ srung 'khor/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ skyabs 'gro ngo sprod/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ bsam du mi rung ba'i 'pho ba/ mos gus/ bla ma sku gsum gyi ngo sprod kyi zhal shes/ lugs bzlog rten 'brel/ phyag rgya chen po/ bsgom pa/ spyod pa/ dam tshig bslab pa gsum/ thun dang po tho rangs ldang dus/ nam mkha' 'jo ba'i bsam gtan/ phyag mchod/ zas kyi rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ rjes kyi rnal 'byor/ bgegs sel/ bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba/ phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad bsal ba/ ting nge 'dzin ngo mi shes pa'i bar chad bsal ba/ nad 'don skabs kyi/ rtsa rlung 'khrugs pa bsal ba/ 'dzag pa srung ba/ sad pa bzhi yis brtag pa/ dngos grub thob kar bar chad bsal ba/ bogs 'don/ sa lam gyi skabs kyi/ sgom med kyi skabs kyi lhan thabs rnams spyan snga rin chen ldan gyis mdzad pa/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid bsdus pa bsam byed sgron me/ chos spyod cha lag gis skor/ drag rlung gnad lnga ma/ 'pho ba hūm̐ dmar ma/ stong nyid rdo rje'i tshig drug ma rtsa 'grel/ gsang spyod rmi lam ma/ gsang spyod zlog bsgom ma tshar chos dang bcas pa/ nad gdon hūm̐ chos ma/ 'dzag srung bka' rgya ma ste snying ma drug ri chos gtam brgyud dar ma bzang pos bsgrigs pa rnams te yon tan kun 'byung gi cha lag tshang ba'o/ /rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad/ de'i lhan thabs sbas bshad kyis zhal gdams/ thabs shes rab gtan la dbab pa/ shes rab kyi yi ge/ rtsa rlung 'khrugs pa'i bgegs sel/ rlung gi man ngag bdun cu pa/ g.yo ba rlung gi zhal shes/

byang sems srung ba'i bka' rgya/ don dam byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid drug rnal 'byor bzhi rim gzhung / lhan thabs zhal gdams te rdo rje lus kyi sbas ba shad kyi skor ro/ /bar do gnad kyi 'phrang sgrol/ lhan thabs zhal shes/ lo rgyus dar ma bzang pos mdzad pa/ bar do'i gtam brgyud des mdzad pa/ 'phrang sgrol gyi khrid yig ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ 'phrang sgrol zhal gyi bdud rtsi ku sa li grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ brda 'grol sbas pa gnad kyi lde mig sgom rin gyis mdzad pa/ ri chos gzhung gi 'khrul 'khor/ bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi 'khrul 'khor rtsa mdud thams cad 'grol ba/ nad 'don gyi 'khrul 'khor bdun/ 'khrul 'khor gyi zhal gdams gsal byed sgron me ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mdzad pa 'phrang sgrol gyi skor te/ ri chos skor gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ti lo shes rab bzang po/ mkhas pa nā ro pa/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen/ dpal ldan mtha' rtsa pa/ 'bri khung pa/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ yang na phag mo grub pa/ rgyal ba gling ras pa/ gtsang pa rgya ras/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin ldan/ khas pa zur phug pa/ mkhas pa ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ grub chen gdan gcig pa gzhon nu dpal ldan/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bde legs rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /yang nye brgyud ni/ yang dgon pa/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum/ chos rje ri khrod pa/ chos rje gzhon nu dpal ldan man gong bzhin/ yang na zur phug pa yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ chos rje dharma ko ṣa/ mnyam med rtogs ldan rin po che/ mnyam ched shākya rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bde legs rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o/

/gtum mo zhag bdun ma yang dgon pas mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma tsa mund+ri/ dpal rga lo/ /zhang g.yu brag pa/ ro sgom pa lhun grub/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga ba rin chen ldan/ zur phug pa/ ratna shrī/ ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ chos rje gzhon nu dpal ldan/ bla ma ratnasti wa/ bla ma bde legs rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin/ sba bzhi'i man ngag 'khrul 'khor/sba bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyi khrid/ ri chos dang bar do 'phrang sgrol mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos/ ri chos dang sba bzhi gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'phrang sgrol dang sba bzhi sogs kyi khyad par ston pa ri chos bar do/ /sa bzhi'i zhal shes snyan brgyud du grags pa rnams thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mal lo/ /bzhad pa rdo rje/ ro skam ras pa/ 'bri sgom gling kha ba/ yer pa ba/ bla ma zhang / ro skam ras pa/ ras chen lhun grub/ sangs rgyas su pa/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin ldan/ zur phug pa/ chos rje ri khrod pa/ chos rje gzhon nu dpal ldan pa/ mnyam med nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bde legs pa man gong bzhin/ ko brag pa'i ha dmigs rgya mtsho zhal gdams dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ko brag pa nas bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho yan bla 'khor mkhan brgyud/ de la mnyam med ras chen/ bde legs rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi che dpag med kyi byin rlabs dbang bskur thob nas/ tshe gzugs brtag pa dang 'chi ltas brtag pa/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'chi ba bslu ba shrī singhas mdzad pa/ nyi ma lha sgra'i rang 'gyur rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'od dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ /ti pu gsang sngags kyi sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ kham pa rdo rje rgyal po/ kyu ra rin po che/ spyan snga rin po che/

chos rje yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/ chos rje zur phug pa/ 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / bla ma dpal ldan bzang po/ bla ma bde legs pa man gong bzhin/ bka' brgyud bla ma brgyud pa thams cad la gsol ba 'debs pa pho nya myur mgyogs yang dgon rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa yang thos so/ /lung sna tshogs thob pa la chos rje sa skya paṇa chen gyi bka' 'bum gyi nang nas/ gang drin ma/ sku'i spyod pa ma/ bde mchog brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ birwa pa'i bstod pa/ rje btsun gyi bstod pa/ gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul ba/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa/ thub pa'i bstod pa lha sar mdzad pa gcig yang thub pa'i bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa/ lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal la bstod pa/ lha sa'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa/ phyag mtshan ri mo'i tshigs bcad/ rgyud gsum 'khor lo'i 'grel pa/ sems bskyed chen mo lung sbyor dang bcas pa/ sdom gsum rab dbye/ sangs rgyas zhu 'phrin/ skyes bu dam pa rnams la phrin yig mkhas pa rnams la springs yig lha rnams la springs yig mi nyag gi bde chen lhun gyi grub pa'i dge 'dun rnams la springs pa/ nyi ma la springs yig chag lo'i dris lan/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i dris lan/ zhang lo tsā ba la springs pa/ nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan/ bka' gdams do skor ba'i dris lan/ snye mo sgom chen gyi dris lan/ theg chen lam gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs rnal du mtshon pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ bsngo ba yon bshad dang bcas pa/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ byis pa 'jug pa'i sgo'i rnam bshad/ nga brgyad rang 'grel dang bcas pa/ sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun po/ yon tan sgrog pa'i tshal la bstod pa/ rta nag ri khud kyi rnga bo che la bstod pa/ skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti la bstod pa/

mu stegs kyi ston pa drug tshar bcad dus kyi tshigs bcad/ tshig gi gter/ dri ba'i tshul mdzad 'phro gcig rol mo'i bstan bcos/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter rnams thob/ yang slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ mañdzu shrī warmas bsgyur gyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rngog lo/ /mchims brtson 'grus seng ge/ mchims don ne/ mchims blo bstan/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ dbu ma pa grub brtson/ gzhon seng / grags pa rgya mtsho/ sad ston grub pa shes rab/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen yon tan dpal bzang / chos rje bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /dbu ma shes spring gi brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ sangs rgyas skyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ de bzhi ka la/ zla grags/ rigs pa'i khu byug e ra pa ti/ ka na ka warma/ ha su ma ti/ de gsum ka la pa tsab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags/ rma bya byang ye/ gtsang pa sa sbos/ zhang thag sag pa/ khu mdo sde 'bar/ de bzhi ka la rma bya byang brtson/ 'tshur gzhon seng / rma bya shākya seng ge/ mchims chen po/ rje btsun byang grub/ dgra bcom dbang grags/ slob dpon bsod nams lhun grub/ 'phags pa byang chub bzang po/ bya bral bsod nams blo gros/ ka bcu pa dar bzang / 'jam dbyangs chos rje man gong bzhin/ chos dbyings bstod pa/ dpe med bstod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ sems kyi rdo rje la bstod pa/ don dam par bstod pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/ bla na med par bstod pa/ 'jam dpal la don dam par bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa/ sku gsum la bstod pa rnams 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa kṛṣṇa paṇḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/

khyad par 'phags bstod slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa/ lha las phul tu byung bar bstod pa slob dpon bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa/ nam langs par bstod pa ka smri rā dza harṣa de was mdzad pa/ skyabs gsum bdun cu pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur/ 'jam dbyangs mjing yon mar grags pa'i bstod pa slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi bsgyur/ slob dpon btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i mdo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta la bstod pa paṇḍi ta su ga ta shrīs mdzad pa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa la bstod pa snyan ngag mkhan chen po lakṣ+mī ka ras mdzad pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la bstod pa wa ra ṇa si'i paṇḍi ta bi dyā ka ras mdzad pa/ slob dpon cha pa chos kyi seng ge'i bstod pa rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ chos rje sa paṇa dang / 'phags pa'i bstod pa gtsang nags phug pas mdzad pa/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar khyi nor dzñā nas mdzad pa/ dka' spyad sgron me/ thub pa dgongs gsal gyi sgrung 'grel zhang mdo sde dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig thos pa rgya mtsho rnams kyi lung thob/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bstod pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/ nyi ma sbas pa/ bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta/ u rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ paṇḍi ta surya gu hya/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ mkhan shāka pa/ sangs gzhon pa/ bsod she ba/ slob dpon shākya 'bum/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag la'o/ /'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa lo chen gyis bsgyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/

dus kyi 'khor lo/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams/ dus zhabs pa/ rgyal sras nā lendā pa/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba/ lha rje sgom pa/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ grub chen yu mo/ /sras dharme shwa ra/ sprul sku jo 'bum/ nam mkha' 'od zer/ se mo che pa/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ chos sku 'od zer/ kun tu bzang po/ byang sems rgyal ye/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇḍi ta ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ chos rje yon tan dpal bzang / rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag la'o/ /yang mtshan brjod 'grel pa sngags don rnam gzigs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ nyi ma'i snying po/ sūrya sidhi/ chos kyi rdo rje/ mu dra siddhi/ de we shwa ra/ smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti/ tshong sde ngag gi dbang phyug kham pa shes rab rdo rje/ rngog chos rdor/ rgya 'a ma can/ shākya seng ge/ khri ston kun dga' 'od/ chos rin/ chos sku ba/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ bla ma dam pa paṇḍi ta/ rje legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag la'o/ /sdud pa dang rdo rje gcod pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ mkhan po stengs chen pa/ blo gros bzang po/ yon tan bzang po/ 'brug sgra sher rgyal/ byang chub bzang po/ yongs 'dzin sūrya/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rje yon tan dpal bzang / rje legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag la'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi yig cha'i lung thob pa la/ bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin gter mdzod/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dri med snang ba/ bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog rtog bdun gyi dkar 'grel/ nag 'grel/

man ngag bcud kyi thigs pa/ lag len khog bsgrigs/ ha la nag po'i shog ril gsum/ bsrung bzlog gi yi ge rnams rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa/ tsu tshundha ra'i rtog pa dang / te'u lo pa'i rtog pa 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas byung ba/ de'i 'grel pa rwa dar ma seng ges mdzad pa/ rtog gsum gyi 'grel pa rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ shog ril gsum gyi 'grel pa bsad pa'i 'khor lo dang / gsod pa'i 'khor lo gnyis rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ mnan pa byas rting mdun ma byed na 'khrul 'khor bdun pa la ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ gtor ma'i cho ga srung 'khor 'bri yig rnams rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ nyi ma bzhi pa rwa 'bum seng gis mdzad pa/ las sbyor des mdzad pa/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rwa rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa dang rgya ston gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ drag po las bdun slob dpon la li tas mdzad pa/ rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur/ zhi ba las bdun dang / drug cu pa'i gtor chog rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ yang rtog bdun gyi ṭī ka rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ 'bri khung lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa'i srung bzlog gi yig skor rnams rje paṇḍi tas phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa thob/ zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa'i sman bla'i cho ga 'bring po'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ zhi ba 'tsho/ khri srong lde btsan/ sad na legs/ khri ral pa can/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje shel gyi rdo rje/ 'od srungs/ dpal 'khor btsan/ nyi ma mgon/ bkra shis lde/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ shes rab grags/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan gro/ zhang ston chos bla/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ grags pa brtson 'grus/ grags pa shes rab/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ grub pa shes rab/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ bla chen yon tan dpal bzang / rje bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rwa los bsgyur/

gshin rje 'byung ba dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i phyir bzlog dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid darpaṇa ā tsāryas mdzad pa/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur/ cha gsum 'bring po shraddhas mdzad pa yang thob/ rgyu ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ lam ston pa la thabs kyi cha ston pa gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa/ shes rab kyi cha ston pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po/ sa lam ston pa mdo sde sa bcu pa/ 'bras bu ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sa ste/ zab mo mdo lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ paṇḍi ta chen po ratna ā ka ra shānti pa/ bal po paṇḍi ta shānta bha dra/ lo tsā ba seng dkar shākya 'od/ khyung po grags seng / she'u dgon pa ba/ byang 'chad dkon ye/ mang dkar tsha lung gi stod ston dkon mchog skyabs/ glang nga ra'i brda ston bsod nams yon tan/ se mo ra pa grub thob yon tan dpal/ bla ma dam pa chos rgyal 'phags pa/ gnur ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kī rti shrī bha dra/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ rje legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ des bdag la'o/ /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ ḍoṃ bi wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ se'u ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ so ma shrī bha dra/ ra hu la bha dra/ bi ma la shrī/ bhe na dha shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ spang sgang ba grags rgyal/ shangs pa grags seng / zhal snga ba bsod rin/ thar gling pa gzhon ye/ shes rab dpal/ dge slong kun nyi/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ ma ti paṇa chen man gong bzhin/ mdo sde mdzangs blun gyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/

klu sgrub/ skal ldan grags/ zla ba grags pa/ chos grags/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ zhi ba'i bshes gnyen/ dzñā na shrī/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ khyung po grags she/ 'or ston lha dbang / so chos she/ zhang dar seng / chos mgon/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kī rti/ paṇa chen ma ti man gong bzhin/ rin po che tog gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba gnyan grags rgyal/ dkon seng / de'i sras rdog pa/ sangs rgyas 'bum man gong bzhin/ phyag na rdo rje'i drag po gsum 'dul gyi 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i myu gu chos bzang gis bsgyur/ gser 'od rnga sgra'i gzungs slob dpon padmas mdzad pa/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 'od zer can gyi gzungs/ rigs gsum mgon po'i mchod rten bzhengs tshul dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug nyams su len tshul rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ thub pa me ru se ṣa'i gzungs/ de'i tshe sgrub byed tshul yi ge rnying pa/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa bram ze phur bus mdzad pa/ snyan ngag me long dpang los bsgyur mchan dang bcas pa lo tsā ba thugs rje dpal las brgyud pa/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khril shing gi sprin gyi gzhon pa'i rtogs brjod lo tsā ba saṃ gha shrī nas brgyud pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsod spang shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma rnams kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ do pa chos she'i gcod skor gsum gyi lung thob/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ kun dga' bo/ /nyi ma gung pa/ sha na'i gos can/ kha che thams cad mkhyen pa/ nyer sbas/ rgya mtsho skyong / dze tā ri/ ngag dbang grags pa/ kha che paṇḍi ta ma ṇi ka shrī/ mal gyo/ la stod pa dbang rin/ mchims chos seng / mchims blo brtan/

chos rje 'jam gsar/ bla ma chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ slob dpon grub rgyal mgon/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /sgrol ma'i las tshogs nyer lnga pa nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ mañdzu shrī dang mal gyis bsgyur gyi brgyud pa ni/ nyi sbas/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ nag po pa/ gu rub lo tsā ba/ rong pa brang ti dar ma snying po/ bla ma sa chen/ mchims khu dbon/ 'jam gsar/ lce mdo sde/ /rong pa rga lo/ /rong pa sher seng / rin po che bsod nams grags/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ mkhan chen byang seng / chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa me tog phreng 'dzin gyi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ dge bsnyen chen po dge ba'i dpal/ paṇḍi ta bsod snyoms stobs kyi go cha/ paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra/ lo tsā ba byams pa dpal/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu rin po che/ rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin po che/ slob dpon don grub rgyal mgon/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin// ༈ /chos rje paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung thob pa la/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar rin po che dbang gi rgyal po/ kyai rdo rje mngon rtogs zab don snying po/ 'khor lo sdom chen gyi sgrub thabs/ sngags phreng / mchod chog bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs phrin las mtha' yas/ dkyil chog gang gā'i chu rgyun/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro lha so bdun gyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ de'i dkyil chog phrin las rgyas byed/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi tshe sgrub/ rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ ma hā ma ya'i mngon rtogs ma nor gsal byed/

rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi sgrub thabs dag pa dang bcas pa/ skyo lugs kyi 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun gyi sgrub thabs nyi 'od 'bar ba/ rta mgrin jo bo lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil chog bsod nams rab rgyas/ rigs gsum spyi'i bdag mdun byed lugs/ de'i dbang bskur ba'i phyag len/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang / dbang chog bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / rnam 'joms ma ṇi badzra gyi lugs lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs gzhan don rab rgyas/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rdo rje 'bar ba/ lha bcu dgu'i dkyil chog dbang gi rgyal po/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi stong mchod byed tshul rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje paṇḍi ta/ rje bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa legs pa'i 'byung gnas nyid kyi gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams kyis lung thob pa la/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dge legs rol pa'i chu gter dang / mthong ba don ldan/ rje sa skya pa chen po la bstod pa yon tan gyi khyad par bco lnga'i sgo nas bsngags pa/ rje btsun rtse mo la thun mong ba'i yon tan gyi tshul 'ga' zhig mtshan spel gyi sgo nas bsngags pa/ yang de nyid la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa bdud rtsi snying po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa mtshan rin po che'i phreng ba/ sa skya paṇḍi ta la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ yang de nyid la bstod pa mtshan gyi phreng ba rnam par spel ba/ yang de nyid la bstod pa phan mdzad ma/ rgyal ba kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa rin po che'i sgrom/ rje btsun kun dga' dbang phyug la bstod pa dad pa'i shugs bskyed/ 'phros las byung pa'i smon lam tshig bcad gnyis/ de nyid la gcig las 'phros pa'i bstod pa/ yang de nyid la bstod pa dpag yas ma/ rab mdzes ma/ yang de nyid la bstod pa yon tan bsngags pa'i phreng ba/

kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge la bstod pa dad ldan ma/ rje dkon mchog 'phel ba la bstod pa rgyal ba'i rigs bdag ma/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan la mtshan spel gyi sgo nas bstod pa dge legs rgyal mtsho ma/ yon tan rgya chen ma/ dngos grub dbang bsgyur ma/ mkhyen brtse ma/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa me tog phreng ba/ rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la bdud rtsi 'bul ba'i tshul/ byang chub sems dpa' yon tan chos rgyal la bstod pa phan bde kun 'byung / rje rwa chen la bstod pa zab rgyas ma dang / dge legs yon tan ma/ rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la bstod pa rab dkar ma/ de nyid la bstod pa sdom pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsngags pa/ de la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa bkra shis kyi grangs rnam par spel ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bde legs rgyal mtshan la bstod pa phan bde ma/ rje rab brtan pa la bstod pa mkhyen rab ma/ bla ma kun brtson la bstod pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs la bstod pa nges don bcud kyi snying po/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lha tshogs la bstod pa rin po che'i tshoms/ thub pa'i dbang po la skyes pa'i rabs kyi sgo nas bstod pa me tog gi phur ma/ shes phyin dkar mo la bstod pa gsal byed sum cu dang rnam par spel ba rgyan gyi phreng ba/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la bstod pa dngos grub kyi pho nya/ rje btsun ma'i bstod pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang khu la bstod pa 'dod pa'i 'bras bu stsol ba/ gaṇḍi la bstod pa gzhan gyi snyan ngag gi dpal rnam par 'phrog pa tshig don rnam par bkra ba/ e waṃ bkod pa la bstod pa theg chen sgra dbyangs ma/ e waṃ gtsug lag khang gi gtso bo rnams kyi bstod pa logs bris las bshus pa/ chos zom gtsug lag khang gi logs ris kyi gtso bo rnams la bstod pa/

rnam thos sras la bstod pa 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' dbang phyug gi rnam thar rin chen phreng ba/ rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams seng ge'i rnam thar nyi ma'i 'od zer/ rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar dgos 'dod kun 'byung / tshul dang po gsum gyi gsal byed zab don nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba/ mngon par rtogs pa ljon shing gi gsal byed zab don bcud kyi snying po/ spyi rnam gyi 'og min sdug po bkod pa'i ngos 'dzin la rtsod pa spong ba stug po bkod pa'i rgyan/ dag ldan gleng gzhi'i gnod sbyin kha sa ra'i lo rgyus/ ljon shing las byung pa'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga cu rtsa bdun dang / rtsa drug gi 'byed tshul bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ rje btsun gyi dkar chag las chos sna so dgu 'dren tshul logs su bkol ba/ rgyud gsum las 'byung ba'i mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgya'i 'dren tshul gzhan lugs cung zad dang bcas pa/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi sngon du gsungs pa'i gsung rgyun/ sdom gsum bsgrag bzung gi thad kyi gsung rgyun/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug pa'i gsung rgyun/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi 'chad thabs/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i sa bcad/ ma hā mā ya'i sa bcad/ rtog bdun sa bcad nyung du rab gsal/ rnam par rgyal ma'i rtog pa che ba'i sa bcad/ la ba pa'i bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi tho/ bong bu'i zhal gyi dbang gi skabs su gsungs pa'i tho/ drag po sgrol dbang gi tho/ dgra gdong gi tho/ 'khor chen gyi dbang gi tho/ ku ru kulle lha lnga'i sgrub thabs padmo'i snying po/ dkyil chog rin po che padma rwa ga'i gter/ srung ba lnga'i tho/ /'od zer can gyi tho/ /gdugs dkar can gyi dbang gi tho/ /gtor chog bcud kyi snying po/ phyir zlog gi 'khor lo bsgom tshul/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang bya tshul/

mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ bsgom bzlas bya tshul/ sha ba ri'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ dze tā ri'i tshe dbang gi tho/ /gza' chog gi tho mdor bsdus/ 'jam dpal smra seng gi rjes gnang bya tshul/ sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs gang blo ma'i rjes gnang bya tshul mchan dang bcas pa/ u tsa'i sgrub thabs bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa/ bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs gzungs rings mchan dang bcas pa/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs gzungs rings mchan dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro'i 'don thabs/ sangs rgyas klu dbang gi sgrub thabs gnyis/ rnam sras kyi rjes gnang bya tshul/ ma ṇi badzra gyi gtor chog nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed bya tshul/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i yin thang bri yig lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i bri yig yas gtam 'bras bu rin po che sna tshogs spel ba/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed bya tshul/ za ma tog bkod pa'i snying po las btus pa/ theg chen lam gyi snying po/ mdo kun las btus pa'i sa bcad/ bslab btus le 'grel bslab pa'i rgyan/ bsgom rim bar ma'i sa bcad 'phags lam snying po/ yum gyi 'brel rkang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sdom/ phar phyin lam gyi rnam gzhag theg chen them skas/ thub pa dgongs gsal gyi 'chad thabs lam bzang snang ba/ yang de'i 'chad thabs rgyal sras lam gyi mdzes rgyan/ de'i mdo sbyor rin po che'i gter/ rje btsun mi la mthar thug gi lta ba ji ltar bzhed pa'i tshul/ rgyal sras lam bzang gi sgrung 'grel bdud rtsi spel ba/ tshad ma rigs gter gyi 'grel bshad rigs pa'i sgo/ /de'i phyogs snga rigs lam gsal byed/ blo rigs sde bdun snying po/ rtags rigs gsal ba'i sgron me/ rje sa skya paṇḍi ta la phrin du gsol ba padmo'i phreng ba/ rje nyid kyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i tshigs bcad/ sdom gsum rab dbye'i skabs kyi don 'ga' zhig ston pa snying gi mun sel/

de'i dka' ba'i gnad 'byed pa zhib mo rnam 'thag sdom gsum gyi gnas gsum gsal byed nor bu chu shel/ yul chen so bdun gyi ngos 'dzin 'khrul med snang ba/ de wī ko ṭa dang / tsa ri tra'i gnas kyi khyad par/ thub chen 'phan la btab pa'i tshigs bcad/ rma bya chen mo'i mdo las byung ba'i ri'i sdoms/ zha lu lo tsā ba la dris lan gnyis/ gnas gsum gsal byed dris lan/ dris lan nges don snying po/ bde gshegs snying po'i gsal byed lung gi phreng ba/ dris lan don gsum gsal byed/ mi'i dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan rgyal sras bzhad pa'i me tog yang de'i dris lan padma'i snying po/ sngon rabs gsal ba'i me long / dris lan ngo mtshar snang ba/ bla ma drung blo ba la gdams pa gsum/ bla ma bzang po/ dpal skyabs/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan rnams la gdams pa re re/ lo tsā ba dpal ldan grags la springs pa gnyis/ chos rgyal nor bu la phul ba'i phrin yig gsum/ mi'i dbang po bkris mgon la phul ba/ a seng rdo rje bstan pa la gnang ba brgyad/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod gzhung gsum/ rgyud gsum dkar chag gi tshigs bcad/ brgyad stong pa bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed gsum/ mdo mang / sa skya bka' 'bum/ lam 'bras brgyud pa sogs bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed re/ yang nyi khri dang / mdo mang bzhengs dus kyi tshigs bcad re re/ shar pa'i gdung rabs/ rin po che'i bstan bcos dgos 'dod kun 'byung / lo gsar dus kyi bkra shis rnams dang / 'khor chen gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs/ phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang dang / gtum po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs re re/ gza' thams cad 'joms pa'i gdugs dkar gyi mngon rtogs/ byams pa la bstod pa gnyis/ sgrol ma dang 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa re re/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad/ rje paṇḍi ta grags pa rdo rje la bstod pa mkhyen rab ma/
